Ka Impakita ni Hisu Kristu

The Revelation of Jesus Christ

ki Huwan

to John

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka Impakita ni Hisu Kristu ki Huwan meyitenged te egkeyitabu keureme. Nasulat seini dengan te timpu ne imbaybayaran ka migmalintutuu tenged te pegpalintutuu ran te Magbebaye ne si Hisu Kristu. Iyan dakel ne tuyu ni Huwan te pegsulat kayi ka pegbehey te egkapallateng diye te migmalintutuu wey pegbagget kandan eyew egpakapabulus ne egpalintutuu minsan egbaybayaran sikandan.

The Revelation of Jesus Christ (MS Hisu Kristu) to John (MS Huwan) is about what will_happen in_the_future. This was_written long ago at a time that the believers were persecuted concerning their believing/faith in the Lord (MS Magbebaye) Jesus Christ. The main (LIT big) reason for John writing this (was) the giving hope to the believers and encouraging them so_that would_continue believing even though they will_be_persecuted.

Iyan kinarakelan ne baad te nasulat kayi ne baseen ka impakita ni Hisu Kristu ki Huwan ne me palinneu ne amana ne kein-inuwan. Ne seeye se langun ne palinneu, due iya kaluwasan wey igpasabut. Te seeye ne timpu, nasabut buwa te me Kristuwanen piru kuntee, due duma ne me palinneu ne amana ne malised ne egkasabut, wey nalein-lein ka me suman-suman te me etew te pegluwas kayi. Piru minsan pad iling due, due degma me palinneu ne malemu re ne egkasabut iling te sungey ne iyan igpasabut se geem wey katenged, wey ka kampilan ne iyan igpasabut se samuk. Inlibed-libed te kamasulug wey te nalein-lein ne paahi ka me uluwan te seini ne baseen pinaahi te me palinneu. Piru malemu re ne egkasabut ka amana ne impurtanti ne nasulat kayi: egdereetan iya te Manama ka langun ne kuntere din pinaahi ki Kristu Hisus, wey egdasahan din degma ka keet-etawan din ne migpabulus migpamakey, wey egpakalemung sikandan kandin te ware egtamanan. Ne due egpakapahale kanta diye te katammanan ne kapitulu, seini meyitenged te iyam ne langit wey tane ne eggimuwen te Manama wey meyitenged te iyam ne Hirusalim ne egtuntunen puun te langit.

The largest portion of what's written here in this document is the signs Christ Jesus revealed to John that were very amazing. And all those signs, indeed have a meaning and an explanation. At that time, (they) were probably understood by the Christians but now, some of the signs are very difficult to understand, and the ideas (LIT thinking) of the people explaining this varies. But even if it's like that, there are also some signs that are just easy to understand like horn(s) that are understood to be power and authority, and sword(s) that are understood to be fighting/trouble. The topics/themes of this document return repeatedly and in various ways by_means of signs. But it's just easy to understand the very important (things) written here: God (MS Manama) will_ indeed _destroy all his enemies at the end of time by_means of Jesus Christ, and he will_ also _reward his people that continue to serve, and they will_live_with him without ending. And there_is (something) to please us(incl) in the final chapter, this is about the new heaven/sky and earth that God will_make and about the new Hirusalim (MS Hirusalim) that will_descend from the sky/heaven.

What's_written(pl) in this document (LIT reading)

11 Seini ne baseen, meyitenged te impakita ni Hisu Kristu ne mahaan e egkeyitabu. Impanengneng te Manama seini diye te kandin eyew igpakapanengneng diye te me etew ne migpamakey kandin. Ne impanengneng din e degma seini diye te suluhuanen din ne si Huwan pinaahi te pegsuhu te panalihan din. 2 Ne impangguhud ni Huwan ka langun ne nakita rin. Impamalehetan din ka lalag te Manama wey ka impanengneng ni Hisu Kristu diye te kandin. 3 Keupianan te seeye se egbasa diye te kasuluhan meyitenged te impanagne kayi, wey ka egpammineg wey egtuman te nasulat kayi su mahaan e egkatuman ka langun.

11 This document, is about what Jesus Christ showed that is soon to happen. This was_made_known to him by God so_that it could be told to the people who serve him. And he also made_known this to his servant John by_means of commanding his angel. 2 And John told (LIT storied) all that he saw. He witnessed_to the word of God and what Jesus Christ made_known to him. 3 Well_being to those who read the prophecies here aloud to many (people), and to the (one who) listens and obeys what is written here because the fulfillment of all is soon.

Ka pegpangemusta diye te pitu ne punduk te migmalintutuu

The greeting to seven groups of believers

4 [xra][xrb]Sikeddiey si Huwan ka migsulat kayi wey igpeendiye ku te pitu ne punduk te migmalintutuu diye te prubinsya te Asya.[fn]

4 [xra][xrb]I am John who wrote this and will_send it to the seven groups of believers there in the province of Asia.[fn]

Ka keyid-u wey keupianan ne egpuun te Manama, wey te pitu ne panisingan[fn] ne diye te tangkaan te trunu rin, egkaangken niyu. Sikandin ka Manama kuntee, ka Manama dengan, wey ka Manama keureme.5 [xra][xrb]Egkaangken niyu man-e ka keyid-u wey keupianan ne egpuun ki Hisu Kristu, ka matinumanen ne talagpamalehet, ka an-anayan ne neuyag, wey ka egmandu te me pangulu te kalibutan.

(May) the mercy and peace/well-being from God, and from the seven spirits[fn] that are in front of his throne, be received by you(pl). He (is) the God now, the God before, and the God in_the_future.5 [xra][xrb](May) you(pl) receive also mercy and peace coming from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the first to come_alive, and the (one who) commands the leaders of the world.

Miggeyinawaan ki nikandin wey inlekat ki puun te me sale ta pinaahi te langesa rin te migpatey,6 [xr]wey inggimu ki nikandin ne migharian din, wey talagpanubad te Manama ne Amey rin. Sikan naa, egdayanen sikandin wey eghari te ware egtamanan. Malehet iya.

We(incl) are loved by him and we(incl) are redeemed from our(incl) sins by_means of his blood when he died,6 [xr]and we(incl) were_made by him into his kingdom, and sacrificers of God his Father. And so, he will_be_praised and will_reign without ending. True indeed.

7 [xra][xrb][xrc]Pammineg kew! Eggendini si Kristu duma te me gapun wey egkiteen sikandin te langun ne etew minsan seeye se miglansang kandin. Egmandalawit ka langun ne tribu kayi te ampew te tane tenged kandin. Malehet iya.

7 [xra][xrb][xrc]Listen(pl)! Christ is/will_come along_with clouds and he will_be_seen by all people even those who nailed him. All the tribes here on top of the ground will_wail/mourn due to him. Yes indeed.

8 [xra][xrb]Ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye ne Manama, ne iyan ka Manama kuntee, ka Manama dengan, wey ka Manama keureme, migkahi, “Sikeddiey ka Alpa wey ka Umiga.”[fn]

8 [xra][xrb]The Very Powerful (LIT Strong) Lord God, who is the God now, the God before, and the God in_the_future, said, “I (am) the Alpa and the Umiga.”[fn]

Ka pegpakita ni Hisus ki Huwan

The revealing of Jesus to John

9 Sikeddiey si Huwan ne suled niyu te pegpalintutuu. Tenged te nasabeka kid e due ki Hisus, duma ad nikaniyu te peg-antus te keyirapan wey te pegpabulus due ki Hisus, wey duma ad degma nikaniyu te peghari te Manama. Indeldel a peendiye te pulu te Patmus tenged te pegwali ku te lalag te Manama wey te pegpamalehet ku meyitenged ki Hisus. 10 Te Duminggu ne Aldew te Magbebaye, in-umaan ad te Panisingan te Manama, ne dutu due narineg ku ne laheng diye te egkeinniyuhan ku ne egpekeiling keemen te trumpita. 11 Miggenendue seini, “Isulat nu diye te linulun ne baseen ke nekey ka egkakita nu wey ipeuyan nu diye te pitu ne punduk te migmalintutuu: diye te Ipisu, Ismirna, Pirgamu, Tiyatira, Sardis, Piladilpiya wey diye te Lawdisya.”

9 I am John your(pl) sibling/friend in believing/faith. Since we(incl) are one with Jesus, I am suffering difficulty(s) along_with (LIT accompanied) you(pl) and in continuing in Jesus, and I also with you(pl) in reigning of God. I was expelled to the island of Patmus due to my preaching the word of God and to my witnessing about Jesus. 10 On Sunday which is the Day of the Lord, I was controlled by the Spirit of God, and then I heard a voice behind me and the loudness was like a trumpet. 11 This went, “Write(sg) there in a rolled document what you(sg) see and send(sg) it there to the seven groups of believers: there in Ipisu, Ismirna, Pirgamu, Tiyatira, Sardis, Piladilpiya and in Lawdisya.”

12 Te sikan de, migbalikid ad ka egpitew ke hentew ka miglalag keddiey, wey iyan ku nakita se pitu ne bulawan ne tahuanan te sulu. 13 [xra][xrb]Ne due migsasindeg diye te taliware kayi ne hendue te etew ne migkukumbale te malayat wey imbeleberan te libed ne bulawan ka kumeng din. 14 [xr][xr]Ne ka bulbul rin egpekeiling kaangkag te gapas, wey ka mata rin egpekeiling te legleg te hapuy. 15 [xr]Ne ka paa rin egpekeiling te inlalab ne burunsi ne migsilak, wey ka laheng din egpekeiling te lehes te dakel ne sampew. 16 Ne miggen-gen ka kawanan ne belad din te pitu ne bituen, wey due miglihawang ne mahalang ne sundang diye te be-be din. Ne ka ulaula rin egpekeiling te aldew ne miglayag te mangune-kune. 17 [xr]Te pegkakita ku kandin, napeled a diye te tangkaan din ne hendue te migpatey e. Ne intel-eban a nikandin te kawanan ne belad din ne migkahi, “Kene ka kaaldek! Sikeddiey ka bunsuranan wey ka katammanan, 18 wey ka due umul; namatey a piru tengtengi nu, neuyag ad wey kena ad egpatey te ware egtamanan. Sikeddiey ka impiyalan te kamatayen wey due yabi ku te Hadis ne iyan ka inged te me gimukud. 19 Purisu isulat nu ke nekey ka nakita nu ne egkeyitabu kuntee wey ka egkeyitabu keureme. 20 Seini ka nekeeles ne kaluwasan te pitu ne bituen ne nakita nu kayi te kawanan ne belad ku wey te pitu ne bulawan ne tahuanan te sulu: ka igpasabut te pitu ne bituen iyan ka me panalihan ne migbantey te pitu ne punduk te migmalintutuu, ne iyan ka pitu ne sulu.”

12 And just then, I turned_around to look who spoke to me, and what_ I _saw was seven gold lamp holders. 13 [xra][xrb]And there_was standing in the middle (something/someone) like a person who was clothed with a long garment and his chest was belted with a gold belt. 14 [xr][xr]And his hair was like the whiteness of cotton, and his eye(s) were_like the flame of fire. 15 [xr]And his foot/feet were_like bronze forged_in_(a_fire) that glows, and his voice was like the sound of a great/large waterfall. 16 And his right hand/arm held seven stars, and a sharp (two-edged) sword coming_out in his mouth. And his face was like the sun shining terribly. 17 [xr]When I saw him, I toppled_over in front of him as if I was dead. And I was laid (LIT covered) by him with his right hand and (he) said, “Don't(sg) be_afraid! I (am) the beginning and the end, 18 and the one living (LIT has life); I died but look(sg), I am alive (again) and I won't die (again) forever (LIT without ending). I am entrusted with death and I have a key for Hadis which is the place of souls. 19 Therefore write(sg) what you(sg) have_seen that happened now and what will_happen in_the_future. 20 This is the hidden meaning of the seven stars that you(sg) saw in my right hand and the seven gold holders of lamps: the meaning of the seven stars (are) the seven angels that guard(ed) seven groups of believers, which (are) the seven lamps.”

Ka sulat peendiye te migmalintutuu diye te Ipisu

The letter to the believers there in Ipisu

21 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Isulat nu seini peendiye te panalihan ne diye te punduk te migmalintutuu te Ipisu:

21 And he said, “Write(sg) this to the angel at the group of believers in Ipisu:

“Seini ka lalag te seeye se miggen-gen ka kawanan ne belad din te pitu ne bituen wey miggiphipanew dutu te taliware te pitu ne bulawan ne tahuanan te sulu.2 Nakanengneng a te hinimuwan niyu, te pegpakannekal niyu te peggimu wey te peg-antus niyu. Kene kew egparuyun-duyun te maddeet ne me etew su eg-el-elehan niyu ka egkahi ne me apustulis kun sikandan, wey iyan egtamanan ka egkanengnengan niyu ne egmanguubat de sikandan. 3 Mig-antus kew wey migpakannekal tenged keddiey wey ware miglunggengu te pegpamakey. 4 Piru iyan ku igkarew-ey kaniyu ne warad e ka dakel ne geyinawa niyu dengan keddiey. 5 Sikan naa, sumsumana niyu kamenu karakel ka geyinawa niyu dengan, wey pekegsendit kew wey himuwa niyu ka inggimu niyu dengan. Su emun ke kene kew egpekegsendit, egbayaan ku sikaniyu wey eg-aween ku ka sulu niyu due te natahuan kayi. 6 Piru due meupiya ne inggimu niyu su igkeepes niyu ka egmangimuwen te me sakup ni Nikulas\f + \fr 2:6 \ft Te Grigu: me Nikulayta. Sikandan ka punduk ne migpanulu ne egkaayun ka migmalintutuu ne eggimu te mallindit, wey eg-iling te batasanen te ware migmalintutuu.\f* ne ingkeepes ku degma.

“This is the word(s) of that (one) who is holding seven stars in his right hand that is walking_around at the middle of seven gold lamp holders.2 I know your(pl) actions, your(pl) striving in working/doing and your(pl) suffering/enduring. You(pl) don't tolerate evil(pl) people because you(pl) have tested (those) who say that they were apostles (hearsay), and_as_a_result you(pl) know that they are just lying. 3 You(pl) endured and strived for me and didn't become_weary in serving. 4 But what_ I _would scold you(pl) for is that your(pl) big love for me before is no_more. 5 So then, remember(pl) how big your(pl) love was before, and regret(pl) and do(pl) what you(pl) did before. Because if you(pl) don't regret(pl), I will_come to you(pl) and I will_remove your(pl) lamp from its place. 6 But there_is something good that you(pl) are_doing because you(pl) dislike what the followers of Nikulayta's\f + \fr 2:6 \ft In Greek: Nikulayta's. They were the group who taught that it is possible for believers to do dirty(pl) (things), and to be like the behavior of non believers.\f* do that I also dislike.

7 [xra][xrb]“Purisu, ka egpakarineg, eg-ayad-ayad egsuman-suman meyitenged te seini ne lalag te Panisingan te Manama\f + \fr 2:7 \ft Te Grigu: Ka due talinga, egpammineg te iglalag te Panisingan.\f* diye te me punduk te migmalintutuu!

7 [xra][xrb]“Therefore, the one_who_hears, think carefully about these words of the Spirit of God\f + \fr 2:7 \ft In Greek: The (one who) has ear(s), listen to what the Spirit is/will_say.\f* to the groups of believers!

“Ka egpanalu ki Meibulan, egbehayan ku te katenged te pegkeen te behas te kayu ne egpakabehey te umul ne diye te ugpaan te Manama.”[fn]

“The (one who) wins over Satan, I will_give authority for eating the fruit of the tree that gives life in the living_place of God.”[fn]

Ka sulat peendiye te migmalintutuu diye te Ismirna

The letter to the believers there in Ismirna

8 [xr]Migkahi e man-e sikandin, “Isulat nu seini peendiye te panalihan ne diye te punduk te migmalintutuu te Ismirna:

8 [xr]He also said, “Write(sg) this to the angel at the group of believers in Ismirna:

“Seini ka lalag te seeye se bunsuranan wey katammanan, ka namatey ne neuyag ded.9 Nakanengneng a ne egbaybayaran kew wey egkaayu-ayu kew, piru ka malehet, meyaman kew. Nakanengneng a degma te imbebayungan kew te me etew ne migkahi ne me Hudiyu kun sikandan, kunaleg te me sakup bes ni Meibulan. 10 Kene kew kaaldek te me kalasayan ne mahaan e egginguma. Eg-el-elehan kew te ahalen te me busew pinaahi te pegprisu te me duma niyu, wey eg-antus kew taman te sapulu ne aldew. Keilangan ne egmatinumanen kew ne eg-ikul keddi minsan egpatey kew, wey eg-unahan ku sikaniyu te umul ne ware egtamanan.\f + \fr 2:10 \ft Te Grigu: egbehayan ku sikaniyu te kuruna te umul.\f*

“This is the word(s) of the (one who) is the beginning and the end, the (one) died that is just come_alive.9 I know that you(pl) are being persecuted and you(pl) are poor, but the truth is, you(pl) are rich. I also know that you(pl) were accused by the people who said they were Hudiyus, whereas they were [surprise] followers of Satan. 10 Don't(pl) be_afraid of the difficulties that will_ soon _arrive. You(pl) will_be_tested by the master of the evil_spirits by_means of the imprisoning of some of you(pl), and you(pl) will_persevere/suffer for (LIT until) ten days. It's_necessary that you(pl) are faithful to follow/imitate me even if you(pl) will_die, and I will_reward you(pl) with life without ending.\f + \fr 2:10 \ft In Greek: I will_give you(pl) a crown of life.\f*

11 [xr]“Purisu, ka egpakarineg, eg-ayad-ayad egsuman-suman meyitenged te seini ne lalag te Panisingan te Manama\f + \fr 2:11 \ft Te Grigu: Ka due talinga, egpammineg te iglalag te Panisingan.\f* diye te me punduk te migmalintutuu!

11 [xr]“Therefore, the one_who_hears, think carefully about these words of the Spirit of God\f + \fr 2:11 \ft In Greek: The (one who) has ear(s), listen to what the Spirit of God is/will_say.\f* to the groups of believers!

“Ka egpanalu ki Meibulan, kenad egkalegparan te ikarangeb ne kamatayen.”

“The (one who) wins over Satan, won't be_punished at/by the second death.”

Ka sulat peendiye te migmalintutuu diye te Pirgamu

The letter to the believers there in Pirgamu

12 Ne migkahi e man-e sikandin, “Isulat nu seini peendiye te panalihan ne diye te punduk te migmalintutuu te Pirgamu:

12 And he/she also said, “Write(sg) this to the angel at the group of believers in Pirgamu:

“Seini ka lalag te seeye se mig-uyan te mahalang ne sundang.13 Nakanengneng a ne duen kew mig-ugpe te inharian ni Meibulan, piru migmatinumanen kew red wey migpabulus migpalintutuu keddi minsan te timpu ne miggimatayan e si Antipas due te kaniyu. Sikandin ka matinumanen ne talagpamalehet ku ne miggimatayan due te in-ugpaan ni Meibulan. 14 [xra][xrb]Piru due pila-pila ne igkarew-ey ku kaniyu: due duma niyu ne mig-ikul te pegpanulu ni Balaam ne iyan migpanulu ki Balak ke egmenuwen te pegsahilut ka me kabuhalan ni Israil eyew egpakasale sikandan pinaahi te pegkeen te impanubad e diye te me diyus-diyus wey pegpeyilabetey ne kene ne alunggun. 15 Ne iling ded, due man-e duma niyu ne mig-ikul te pegpanulu te me sakup ni Nikulas. 16 Purisu inniyuhi niyu ka me sale niyu! Emun ke kene, egbayaan ku sikaniyu te mahaan wey egpakig-ehet a te me etew ne miggimu te mareet, pinaahi te sundang ne eglihawang te be-be ku.

“This is the word(s) of that/those who carry/bring/take the sharp (two-edged) sword.13 I know that you(pl) live there in the reigning_place of Satan, but you(pl) are still faithful and continue to believe me even at the time that Antipas was_killed among you(pl). He was my faithful witness who was_killed there where Satan lives. 14 [xra][xrb]But I have a few_things to scold_ you(pl) _for: there are some among you(pl) who follow/imitate the teaching of Balaam who taught Balak how to entice the descendants of Israil so_that they would_sin by_means of eating what was sacrificed to false_gods and by being sexually_immoral (LIT meddling without being_married). 15 Likewise, there are also some among you(pl) who follow/imitate the teaching of the followers of Nikulas. 16 Therefore turn_from(pl) your(pl) sins! If not, I will_come to you(pl) quickly and fight_against the people that did evil, by_means of the (two edged) sword that is_coming out of my mouth.

17 [xra][xrb]“Purisu, ka egpakarineg, eg-ayad-ayad egsuman-suman meyitenged te seini ne lalag te Panisingan te Manama\f + \fr 2:17 \ft Te Grigu: Ka due talinga, egpammineg te iglalag te Panisingan.\f* diye te me punduk te migmalintutuu!

17 [xra][xrb]“Therefore, the one_who_hears, think carefully about these words of the Spirit of God\f + \fr 2:17 \ft In Greek: The (one who) has ear(s), listen to what the Spirit is/will_say.\f* to the groups of believers!

“Ka egpanalu ki Meibulan, egbehayan ku te egkakeen ne mana ne inneles wey te maangkag ne batu ne nasulatan te iyam ne ngaran ne ware minsan hentew ne nakanengneng kayi angin e te egpakarawat kayi.”

“The (one who) wins over Satan, I will_give hidden food that is mana and a white stone written with a new name and no one knows it except the one receiving it.”

Ka sulat peendiye te migmalintutuu diye te Tiyatira

The letter to the believers there in Tiyatira

18 Ne migpabulus sikandin migkahi, “Isulat nu seini peendiye te panalihan ne diye te punduk te migmalintutuu te Tiyatira:

18 And he continued saying, “Write(sg) this to the angel at the group of believers in Tiyatira:

“Seini ka lalag te Anak te Manama, ne egpekeiling se mata te legleg te hapuy wey egpekeiling se paa te inlalab ne burunsi ne migsilak.19 Nakanengneng a te hinimuwan niyu wey te pegpapitew niyu te geyinawa wey te pegpalintutuu niyu. Nakanengneng a degma te pegpamakey niyu wey te peg-antus niyu, wey subla pad te an-anayan ka inggimu niyu kuntee. 20 [xr]Piru iyan ku igkarew-ey kaniyu ka pegparuyun-duyun niyu te malitan ne si Hisabil ne migkahi ne prupita kun sikandin. Ne eg-unahan ku ka tagse sabeka sumale te hinimuwan din.

Ka pegsimba diye te langit

Worshiping in heaven/sky

41 Pegkapenga dutu, duen e man-e lein ne nakita ku. Due nakita ku ne gumawan ne nalukatan diye te langit. Ne narineg kud man-e ka laheng ne narineg ku te an-anayan ne egpekeiling te trumpita ne migkahi, “Pamaneyik ka kayi su igpapitew ku keykew ka egkeyitabu keureme.” 2 [xr]Sahuhune ne in-umaan ad te Panisingan te Manama, wey te sikan de nakakita a te sabeka ne trunu diye te langit ne due migpinnuu. 3 Ne miglayag ka migpinnuu dutu iling te mahal ne batu ne haspi wey kurnalina, wey nalingutan ka trunu te baluntu ne egpekeiling ka batek te batu ne ismiralda. 4 Ne nalingutan ka trunu te daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at (24) ne trunu ne naminnuuwan te daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at (24) ne igbuyag ne nangukumbale te maangkag wey nangukuruna te bulawan. 5 [xra][xrb][xrc]Ne ligkat te trunu, miggeteb ka kilat wey due migderaheneg wey migdagsang ka luhung. Ne due pitu ne ganse ne egkalegleg diye te tangkaan te trunu ne iyan seeye se pitu ne panisingan te Manama.[fn] 6 [xr][xr]Ne diye te egkatangkaan te trunu, due egpekeiling te dahat ne bildu ne titing-awi iling te kristal.

41 When that was done, there_was also something else that I saw. There was a doorway I saw that was_opened in heaven/sky. And I also heard the voice which I had heard at first that was like a trumpet that said, “Ascend(sg) here because I will_show you(sg) what will_happen in_the_future.” 2 [xr]Suddenly I was controlled by the Spirit of God, and at that I saw in heaven/sky one throne with (someone) sitting (on it). 3 And the one sitting there shone like expensive haspi and kurnalina stones, and the throne was_surrounded by a rainbow like the color of ismiralda stone. 4 And the throne was_surrounded by twenty-four (24) thrones sat on by twenty-four (24) elders clothed in white and crowned in gold. 5 [xra][xrb][xrc]And from the throne, the lightning flashed and there_was a_booming_sound and the thunder crashed. And there were seven torches blazing in front of the throne which were the seven spirits of God.[fn] 6 [xr][xr]And there in front of the throne, there_was (something) like a glass sea that was very_transparent like crystal.

Ne due nakalingut te trunu ne hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa ne neempet te mata ka tangkaan wey peka.7 Egpekeiling te liyun ka an-anayan ne hinimuwan, ne egpekeiling te nati te baka ka igkarangeb, ne egpekeiling te ulaula te etew ka ulaula te igkatatelu, ne egpekeiling te miglayang ne banug ka igkeep-at ne hinimuwan. 8 [xra][xrb]Tighen-em-hen-em te pakpak ka tagse sabeka wey neempet te me mata ka intiru ne lawa ran minsan ka diye te diralem te pakpak dan. Ka linulun ne baseen wey ka Nati ne Karniru

51 [xr]Ne nakita ku seeye se migpinnuu te trunu ne due linulun ne baseen ne miggen-genan din te kawanan ne belad din. Nekeglimang ka nasulatan dutu wey impiket te pitu ne piket. 2 Ne due nakita ku ne maresen ne panalihan ne migpanaman-taman migpanguleyi ne migkahi, “Hentew-a ka likes ne eglekat te me piket te egbaseen eyew egkabukalasan seini?” 3 Ne ware minsan hentew diye te langit wey diye te ampew te tane wey ke diye naa te diralem te tane ne egpakabukalas wey ke egpakabasa naa dutu. 4 Ne migpanaman-taman a migsinehew su ware sabeka ne nakita ne likes ne egbukelas te baseen wey ke egbasa naa dutu. 5 [xra][xrb]Piru due sabeka te me igbuyag ne migkahi keddiey, “Kene ka sinehew! Pammineg ka, migpanalu ki Meibulan ka egngaranan te Liyun ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Huda wey kabuhalan ni Dabid, sikan naa ka likes sikandin ne eglekat te me piket eyew egkabukalasan ka baseen.”

51 [xr]And I saw that/those seated on the throne was holding a rolled_up document in his/her right hand. The writing was double-sided and stuck with seven stickers. 2 And I saw a powerful (LIT strong) angel that loudly shouted saying, “Who is worthy to open the sticker on the document in_order to unroll it?” 3 And no one in heaven/sky and on top of the earth or under the earth could unroll that or read it. 4 And I cried bitterly because no one was found who was worthy to open the document or to read it. 5 [xra][xrb]But there_was one of the elders who said to me, “Don't cry(sg)! Listen(sg), the one_called Liyun from the descendants of Huda and a descendant of Dabid has defeated Satan, and so he's worthy to open the stickers in_order_to unroll the document.”

6 [xra][xrb]Nataman, nakakita a te sabeka ne Nati ne Karniru ne migsasindeg diye te elat-elat te hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa wey te me igbuyag ne miglingut te trunu. Hendue te neyimatayan e seeye dengan. Due pitu ne sungey wey pitu ne mata dutu ne iyan ka pitu ne panisingan te Manama[fn] ne impeendiye te langun ne inged kayi te kalibutan. 7 Ne migparani sikandin wey ingkuwa rin ka egbaseen diye te kawanan ne belad te seeye se migpinnuu te trunu. 8 [xr]Te naangey e seeye te Nati ne Karniru, mig-usengul e diye te tangkaan din ka hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa wey ka daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at (24) ne me igbuyag. Ka tagse sabeka kandan migpangelit te alpa wey due miggen-genan dan ne yahung ne bulawan ne napenu te insinsu ne iyan ka me peg-ampu te me keet-etawan te Manama. 9 [xr]Ne nangulahing e sikandan te iyam ne ulahingen ne eggenendue:

6 [xra][xrb]Then, I saw a (LIT one) Lamb (LIT Sheep lamb) that stood between the four breathing creatures and the elders who surrounded the throne. It_was_as_if it had been_killed before. It had seven horns and seven eyes that were the seven spirits of God[fn] that went to all places here in the world. 7 And he approached and he took the document from the right hand/arm of that (one) seated on the throne. 8 [xr]When it was_taken by the Lamb, the four breathing creatures and the twenty-four (24) elders bowed_their_face_to_the_ground at his front. Each one of them plucked a harp and they held gold bowl filled with incense that was the prayers of the people of God. 9 [xr]And they sung(pl) a new song which goes:

“Likes ka ne eg-angey te baseen

wey te peglekat te me piket kayi.

due me etew ne nalekat nu eyew egkeyimu ne keet-etawan te Manama,

ne namuun te tagse tribu,

from every tribe,

me linalahan wey me kabuhalan, wey me nasud.10 [xr]Inggimu nu sikandan ne migharian

languages and line_of_descents, and nations.10 [xr]You(sg) made them kingdom(s)

wey me talagpanubad te kanta ne Manama,

and sacrificers of our(incl) God,

wey eghari sikandan te kalibutan.”

and they will_reign_over the world.”

11 [xr]Nataman, migtengteng ad e man-e wey narineg ku ka laheng te kene egkaseel ne me panalihan te Manama ne nakalingut te trunu, wey te hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa wey te me igbuyag. 12 Nangulahing sikandan te heemeni ne miggenendue:

11 [xr]Then, I looked again and I heard the voice/sound of uncountable angels of God surrounding the throne, and of the four breathing creatures and the elders. 12 They sang(pl) very_loud that went:

and he is worthy to be respected, honored, and praised!”

13 Ne narineg ku ka langun ne miggeheyinawa diye te langit wey diye te ampew te tane, wey ka diye te diralem te tane wey diye te dahat ne nangulahing ne miggenendue:

without ending!”

Ka peglekat te me piket

Opening of the stickers

61 Nataman, nakita ku ka Nati ne Karniru ne miglekat te sabeka te pitu ne piket, wey te sikan de, nakarineg a te sabeka te hep-at ne me hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa ne miglalag. Egpekeiling te luhung ka laheng din ne miggenendue, “Hendini ka!” 2 [xr]Ne due nakita ku ne maangkag ne kudde ne migpanguddaan te etew ne due piet. Imbehayan sikandin te kuruna wey miggipanew ne migpanpanalu te me kuntere din. 3 Ne inlekat e man-e te Nati ne Karniru ka igkarangeb ne piket, wey narineg ku ka igkarangeb ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa ne migkahi, “Hendini ka!” 4 [xr]Ne due miglihawang ne dangeb ne kudde ne malalab wey migpanguddaan te etew ne imbehayan te katenged te peg-awe te keupianan te kalibutan eyew egmeyimmimatayey ka me etew. Ne imbehayan sikandin te bubuyahen ne kampilan. 5 [xr]Ne inlekat e man-e te Nati ne Karniru ka igkatelu ne piket, wey narineg ku man-e ka igkatatelu ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa ne migkahi, “Hendini ka!” Ne due nakita ku ne meitem ne kudde ne migpanguddaan te etew ne mig-uyan te timbangan. 6 Ne due laheng ne narineg ku ne hendue te diye migpuun te taliware te hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa ne migkahi, “Tatelu ne salmun ne trigu wey ke siyam ne salmun ne sibada ka egkeutel te suul te etew te sabeka ne aldew. Piru kene nu hilabeti ka mentika wey ka binu!”

61 Then, I saw the Lamb that opened one of the seven stickers, and just then, I heard one of the four breathing creatures speaking. Its voice is like a thunder that went, “Come_here(sg)!” 2 [xr]And I saw a white horse ridden by a person with a bow. He (the person) was_given a crown and he went and won_(repeatedly) over his enemies. 3 And the Lamb also opened the second sticker, and I heard the second breathing creature say, “Come_here(sg)!” 4 [xr]And another horse exited that was red and ridden by a person that was_given authority for removing well_being from the world so_that the people would kill_each_other(pl). And he was_given a huge sword. 5 [xr]And the Lamb also opened the third sticker, and I also heard the third breathing creature that said, “Come_here(sg)!” And I saw a black horse ridden by a person carrying scales. 6 And I heard the voice which was like it was coming from the middle of the four breathing creatures that said, “Three salmon_cans of wheat or nine salmon_cans of barley is what_can_be_bought with payment for a person for one day. But don't(sg) touch/destroy cooking_oil or wine!”

7 Ne inlekat e man-e te Nati ne Karniru ka igkeep-at ne piket, wey narineg ku ka igkeep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa ne migkahi, “Hendini ka!” 8 [xr]Ne iyan ku nakita ka kudde ne egmakalawag ne migpanguddaan te egngaranan te Kamatayen, wey migsinundul kandin ka egngaranan te Hadis. Imbehayan sikandan te geem te pegpangimatey te igkeep-at ne baad te me etew te kalibutan pinaahi te gira, te gutas, te dalu wey pinaahi te mahintalunan ne me mananap kayi te kalibutan.

7 And the Lamb also opened the fourth sticker, and I heard the fourth breathing creature which said, “Come_here(sg)!” 8 [xr]And what_ I _saw was the sickly_pale horse that was ridden by named Death, the one named Hades followed him. They were_given power for killing a fourth portion of the people of the world by_means of war, hunger, sickness and by_means of wild animals here in the world.

9 Ne inlekat e man-e te Nati ne Karniru ka igkalimma ne piket, wey due nakita ku diye te diralem te altar ne me gimukud te me etew ne immangimatayan tenged te pegtuman dan te lalag te Manama wey te pegmatinumanen dan te pegpanengneng kayi. 10 Ne migpanaman-taman sikandan migmanguleyi, “Manama ne amana ne maresen, ka matulus wey malehet; ken-u nu pad eggukumi wey egsulii ka me etew ne miggimatey kanami diye te kalibutan?” 11 Ne impamehayan e ka tagse sabeka kandan te maangkag ne kumbale ne malayat wey migkahiyan te egpeyimelayen pad te dagdahew re taman te egkasampung e ka kasuluhan te me suled dan ne duma ran te migpamakey te Manama ne egpangimatayan iling te natamanan dan.

9 Then the Lamb also opened the fifth sticker, at the bottom of the altar I saw the souls of the people killed(pl) due to their obeying the word of God and for their being faithful in making_ it _known. 10 And they shouted loudly, “Very powerful God, the holy and true (one); when will_ you(sg) _judge and avenge/revenge the people that kill(ed) us(excl) there in the world?” 11 And each one of them was_given long white clothing and told to rest for a while until the number of their relatives/friends will_be_exact who were serving God along_with them and would_be_killed like their ending.

12 [xra][xrb]Ne nakita ku ne inlekat e man-e te Nati ne Karniru ka igkeen-em ne piket. Ne dutu, miglilinug e te amana ne nenekali wey migmarusilem e ka aldew iling te meitem ne manggad, wey migmalalab e ka bulan iling te langesa. 13 [xr]Neneulug diye te tane ka me bituen diye te langit iling te meyilew pad ne behas te kayu ne imbayaan te makeseg ne kalamag. 14 [xr]Naawe ka langit iling te baseen ne inlulun, wey nenaalin ka langun ne me bubungan wey ka me pulu puun te natahuan dan. 15 [xr]Nangeles diye te me sulung wey te me pahang diye te me bubungan ka me Hari te kalibutan wey ka me pangulu, ka me labew te me sundalu, ka me meyaman, ka dakel se katenged ne me etew, ka me uripen wey ka kene ne me uripen. 16 [xr]Migpangananey sikandan te me bubungan wey te me pahang ne migkahi, “Tebali key eyew egkabunbunan key wey kenad egkiteen te migpinnuu te trunu, wey egpakapanalliya key te langet te Nati ne Karniru. 17 [xr]Su miggingume e ka makaalat-halat ne aldew te pegparusa te langun ne etew, wey ware iya egpakatiis kayi.”

12 [xra][xrb]And I saw that the Lamb opened also the sixth sticker. And there, it earthquaked very strongly and the sun darkened like a black cloth, and the moon reddenned like blood. 13 [xr]The stars in the sky/heaven fell(pl) to the ground like still unripe fruits of a tree that a strong wind passed_by. 14 [xr]The sky/heaven was_removed like a rolled_up document, and all of the mountains and the islands were moved(pl) from their places. 15 [xr]The kings of the world and the leaders, the ones_over the soldiers, the wealthy, the people with big authority, the slaves and the not-slaves hid(pl) in caves and in the cliffs/rocks in the mountains. 16 [xr]They pleaded_for_mercy to the mountains and the cliffs/rocks saying, “Fall_down_on us(excl) so_that we(excl) will_be_covered and won't be_able_to_see by the (one) sitting on the throne, and we(excl) can avoid the anger of the Lamb. 17 [xr]Because the terrifying day arrived for punishing all the people, and no_(one)/nothing indeed can endure/survive this.”

Ka 144,000 ne etew ne nakulitan

The 144,000 people that were marked

71 [xr]Te pegkapenga kayi, due nakita ku ne hep-at ne panalihan ne migsasindeg diye te hep-at ne pikungan te kalibutan. Impahenan dan ka hep-at ne kalamag te kalibutan eyew kene egkakalamahan ka tane, dahat, wey ka minsan nekey ne kayu. 2 Nataman, duen e man-e nakita ku ne lein ne panalihan ne migparibabew diye te langit puun te igsile ne mig-uyan te kulit te manekal ne Manama. Ne migpanaman-taman sikandin migpanguleyi ka migpangumew te hep-at ne panalihan ne imbehayan te Manama te geem te pegdereet te tane wey te dahat. 3 [xr]Migkahi sikandin, “Kene niyu pa dereeti ka tane, ka dahat, wey ka kakayuwan taman te egkakulitan ney e ka buked te me suluhuanen te kanta ne Manama.” 4 Ne nakarineg a ne due sabeka ne gatus wey hep-at ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (144,000) ne etew ka nakulitan puun te langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. 5 Due sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Huda, sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, wey sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Gad. 6 Due sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Asir, sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Naptali, wey sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Manasis. 7 Due sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Simyun, sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Libi, wey sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Isakar. 8 Due sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Sabulun, sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Husi, wey sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) puun te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin.

71 [xr]When this was_finished, there were four angel(s) I saw that stand/stood at the four corners of the world. They restrained the four wind(s) of the world so_that the land, sea, and any tree would not be blown_on. 2 Then, there_was again another (LIT different) angel I saw that ascended to the sky/heaven from the east who carried a mark of the strong/living God. And he shouted loudly calling the four angels which were_given power by God for destroying the earth and the sea. 3 [xr]He said, “Don't(pl) destroy the earth, the sea, and the trees yet until we(excl) have marked the forehead(s) of the servants of our(incl) God.” 4 And I heard that there were one-hundred and forty-four thousand (144,000) people that were marked from all the tribes of Israil. 5 There were twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendant of Huda, twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Rubin, and twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Gad. 6 There were twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Asir, twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Naptali, and twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Manasis. 7 There were twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Simyun, twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Libi, and twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Isakar. 8 There were twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Sabulun, twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Husi, and twelve thousand (12,000) from the descendants of Binhamin.

Ka susuluhi ne etew ne nangukumbale te maangkag

The many people clothed(pl) in white

9 Pegkapenga dutu, due nakita ku ne susuluhi ne me etew ne kene egkaseel ne namuun te nalein-lein ne me nasud, me tribu wey me kabuhalan, wey me linalahan. Diye sikandan nanasindeg te tangkaan te trunu wey te Nati ne Karniru ne nangukumbale te maangkag wey nangekemkem te dewun te palmira ne egpekeiling te niyug. 10 Ne migpanaman-taman sikandan migmanguleyi ne miggenendue: “Iyan migluwas kanta ka Manama ne migpinnuu te trunu wey ka Nati ne Karniru!” 11 Ne miglingut nanasindeg ka langun ne me panalihan diye te trunu, wey diye te me igbuyag wey diye te hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa. Ne mig-usengul sikandan diye te tangkaan te trunu wey migsimba te Manama. 12 Ne migkahi sikandan, “Malehet iya! Ka Manama likes ne egdayanen, egtahuren, wey egpasalamatan su mabantug sikandin, matagseb, maresen wey manekal te ware egtamanan. Malehet iya.”

9 When that was_finished, there were very_many people I saw that couldn't be_counted coming_from(pl) various nations, tribes and line_of_descents, and languages. They stood(pl) there in front of the throne and of the Lamb dressed(pl) in white and holding(pl) leaves of palm that is like coconut_(tree). 10 And they shouted loudly that went: “The (ones) who saved us(incl) (are) God who sits/sat on the throne and the Lamb!” 11 And all the angels stood surrounding the throne, and (around) the elders and (around) the four breathing creatures. And they bowed_their_face_to_the_ground in front of the throne and worshiped God. 12 And they said, “Indeed true! God is worthy to be_praised, respected, and thanked because he is great, wise, powerful and strong without ending. Indeed true.”

13 Nataman, mig-insaan a te sabeka te me igbuyag, “Hentew-a ka sika ne me etew ne nangukumbale te maangkag, wey hendei sikandan namuun?”

13 Then, I was_asked by one of the elders, “Who are those people dressed(pl) in white, and where are they from(pl)?”

14 [xr]Ne migtabak a, “Ahalen, sikeykew ka nakataha ke hentew sikandan.”

14 [xr]And I answered, “Master, you(sg) (are) the (one who) knows who they are.”

Ne migkahiyan a nikandin, “Sika ka me etew ne nakaantus te masumpit ne pegbayad-bayad. Impi-pian dan ka me kumbale dan te langesa te Nati ne Karniru eyew egmaangkag.[fn]15 Sikan naa ka kayi sikandan te tangkaan te trunu te Manama, wey migpamakey kandin te maaldew wey marusilem diye te timplu rin. Ne layun sikandan egdumeyi wey egbantayi te seeye se migpinnuu te trunu. 16 [xr]Kenad e sikandan egmanggutasan wey egkengammaraan, wey kenad e sikandan egkatutung te aldew wey te minsan nekey pad ne egpakatutung. 17 [xra][xrb][xrc]Su ka Nati ne Karniru ne diye te elat-elat te trunu, iyan egtanggu wey egpanulud kandan diye te me sebseb ne egpakabehey te umul. Ne egpunasen te Manama ka tagse luwe dan ne egtihis.”

And he told me, “Those (are) the people who have endured great persecution. They have washed their clothes with the blood of the Lamb in_order to become_white.[fn]15 That's why they are in front of the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. And they are always accompanied and guarded by that (one) who sits on the throne. 16 [xr]They won't hunger(pl) anymore nor be thirsty(pl), and they won't be burnt again by the sun or by anything else that burns. 17 [xra][xrb][xrc]Because the Lamb in the center of the throne, (is) the one looking_after and guiding them to the springs (of waters) that can_give life. And God will_wipe_away their every tear that will_drip.”

Ka peglekat te igkapitu ne piket

The opening of the seventh sticker

81 Te inlekat e te Nati ne Karniru ka igkapitu ne piket, warad iya dahing ne egkarineg diye te langit te me liware te uras. 2 Nataman, nakita ku ka pitu ne panalihan ne nanasindeg diye te tangkaan te Manama, wey impamehayan sikandan te tigsalimbeka ne trumpita.

81 When the Lamb opened the seventh sticker, no sound could be heard in heaven/sky for about half an hour. 2 Then, I saw the seven angels who were standing in front of God, and they were each given a trumpet.

3 [xra][xrb]Ne due lein ne panalihan ne migginguma ne miggen-gen te tahuanan te insinsu ne bulawan ne diye migsasindeg te tangkaan te altar. Imbehayan pad man-e sikandin te dakel ne insinsu eyew igtimul te peg-ampu te me keet-etawan te Manama ne igpanubad diye te altar ne bulawan ne diye te egkatangkaan te trunu. 4 Ne migparibabew diye te tangkaan te Manama ka ebel te insinsu ne miggen-genan te panalihan wey insewuhan seeye te me peg-ampu te keet-etawan te Manama. 5 [xra][xrb]Nataman, ingkuwe e te panalihan ka tahuanan te insinsu wey innipenu din e te hapuy puun te altar wey indegpak din diye te tane. Ne sahuhune ne migdagsang ka meemen ne luhung, wey due migderaheneg, wey miggeteb ka kilat wey miglilinug pad.

3 [xra][xrb]And there_was another angel that arrived and held a gold incense holder and stood in front of the altar. He/She was_given lots of incense in_order_to add to the prayers of the people of God that will_be_sacrificed on the gold altar in front of the throne. 4 And the smoke of the incense held by the angel rose in front of God and it was mixed with the prayers of the people of God. 5 [xra][xrb]Then, the angel took the holder of incense and he filled it with fire from the altar and he threw it to the ground. And suddenly it thundered loudly, and there_was a_booming_sound, and lightning_flashed and (it) earthquaked.

Ka pitu ne trumpita

The seven trumpets

6 Nataman, migpangandam e ka pitu ne panalihan ne nangen-gen te tigsalimbeka ne trumpita eyew igparahing.

6 Then, the seven angels who held each a trumpet prepared(pl) in_order_to sound (them).

7 [xr]Ne imparahing e te an-anayan ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, wey due apiyew wey hapuy ne nasewuhan te langesa ne nakaregpak diye te tane. Ne natutung ka igkatelu ne baad te tane wey me kayu, wey ka langun ne hilamunen.

7 [xr]And the first angel sounded his trumpet, and there_was hail and fire mixed with blood that was_thrown to the ground. And a third portion of the ground and trees were burnt, and all the weeds/grass.

8 Ne imparahing e te igkarangeb ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, wey due egpekeiling te bubuyahen ne bubungan ne egkalegleg ne nakaregpak diye te dahat. Ne puun due, neyimu e ne langesa ka igkatatelu ne baad te dahat 9 wey nammatey ka igkatatelu ne baad te langun ne eggeheyinawa diye te dahat, wey nagguhus ka igkatatelu ne baad te me unturanan diye dahat.

8 And the second angel sounded his trumpet, and there_was like a great mountain blazing that was thrown into the sea. And from that, a third of the sea became blood 9 and one third of everything that breathes in the sea died(pl), and one third of the vehicles in the sea were demolished/destroyed(pl).

10 [xr]Ne imparahing e te igkatatelu ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, wey due dakel ne bituen ne egkalegleg iling te ganse ne neulug puun te langit wey diye migdeeg te igkatatelu ne baad te me weyig wey te me sebseb. 11 [xr]Mapeit ka ngaran te bituen. Ne dutu, migmapeit e ka igkatatelu ne baad te me weyig, wey masalig ka me etew ne migpatey su migmapeit man-e ka weyig.

10 [xr]And the third angel sounded his trumpet, and there_was a big star blazing like a torch that fell from the sky/heaven and struck a third of the rivers/waters and springs. 11 [xr]The name of the star was Bitter. And then, a third of the rivers/waters became_bitter, and many people died(pl) because the water had become_bitter.

12 [xr]Ne imparahing e te igkeep-at ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, wey nasuhat ka igkatatelu ne baad te aldew wey te bulan, wey te me bituen. Sikan naa ka naawe ka igkatatelu ne baad te kalayag dan, wey migmarusilem e ka igkatatelu ne baad te maaldew wey ka igkatatelu ne baad te marusilem.

12 [xr]And the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and one third of the sun and of the moon were hit, and of the stars. So then a third of their light was_removed, and a third of the day and a third of the night darkened.

13 Nataman, due nakita ku ne banug ne miglayang diye te aw-awangan wey narineg ku sikandin ka migpanaman-taman migpanguleyi ne migkahi, “Mekeyid-u-hid-u naan de iya! Mekeyid-u-hid-u iya! Mekeyid-u-hid-u naan de iya ka nangugpe te kalibutan ke igparahing e te nahaat ne tatelu ne panalihan ka me trumpita ran ne mahaan e igparahing.”

13 Then, there_was an eagle I saw flying in the atmosphere and I heard it shouting loudly saying, “Truly pitiful! Pitiful indeed! Those who live(pl) in the world are truly pitiful if/when the remaining three angels sound their trumpets that are soon to sound.”

91 Ne imparahing e te igkalalimma ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, wey due nakita ku ne sabeka ne bituen ne neulug diye te tane puun te langit. Imbehayan ka bituen te yabi te bitu ne ware tamanan. 2 [xr]Inlukatan din ka bitu ne ware tamanan wey due miglihawang ne ebel puun dutu ne egpekeiling te ebel te bubuyahen ne hapuy. Ne migmarusilem e ka kalibutan tenged su naringdingan e te ebel ka layag te aldew. 3 [xr]Ne due migmanlihawang ne talangas puun te ebel wey migmanlene diye te tane. Imbehayan sikandan te katenged te pegpanehed iling te me salipit-sipit. 4 [xr]Impanpanayan sikandan ne kene egpabalbalangan ka me hilamunen, wey ke pinamula, wey me kayu naa. Ke kene, iyan de egpabalbalangan seeye se me etew ne ware nakuliti ka me buked dan te kulit te Manama. 5 Intuhutan ka me talangas te pegbayad-bayad te me etew seled te lalimma ne bulan piru kene de egpeyimatayan. Ka kandan ne pegbayad-bayad iling kasakit te eggeramen te etew ne insehed te salipit-sipit. 6 [xr]Te seeye ne timpu, egkeupian e perem ka me etew ne egkengammatey wey eg-iman-iman e sikandan ne egkengabigtawan piru kene sikandan egkengammatey.

91 And the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and there_was a star I saw fell to the ground from the sky/heaven. The star was_given the key of the pit without ending. 2 [xr]He opened the pit without ending and smoke came out from it like smoke of a great fire. And the world went_dark because the light of the sun was blocked by the smoke. 3 [xr]And there were locusts that came_out(pl) from the smoke and descended(pl) to the ground. And they were_given authority to sting(pl) like scorpions. 4 [xr]They were_warned not to ruin the weeds/grass, or plants, or trees. Rather, (they) were to ruin those people not marked by God's mark on their foreheads. 5 The locusts were allowed to persecute the people for (LIT inside) five months but just not to kill (them). Their persecuting was like the soreness felt by a person/people stung by a scorpion. 6 [xr]At that time, the people want to die(pl) and they hope that they would go_unconscious/die(pl) but they won't die(pl).

7 [xr]Egpekeiling ka me talangas te me kudde ne in-andam e eyew egbubunu wey migkukuruna sikandan te egpekeiling te bulawan, wey egpekeiling te ulaula te me etew ka ulaula ran. 8 [xr]Ne mallayat ka me bulbul ran iling te bulbul te me malitan wey ka me ngipen dan egpekeiling te ngipen te liyun. 9 [xr]Ne due dingding te me kumeng dan ne egpekeiling te putew, wey ka kahulub te me pakpak dan egpekeiling kahulub te sesalihi ne karwahi ne ingganuy te me kudde ne nanlungkesu peendiye te bunuanan. 10 Ne due geem te ikug dan ne egpekeiling te ikug te salipit-sipit ne due sehed, wey seini ka eggamiten dan te pegpabayad-bayad te me etew seled te lalimma ne bulan. 11 Ne due Hari ne migmandu kandan ne iyan ka panalihan ne due katenged te bitu ne ware tamanan. Ka ngaran din te Hibruwanen ne linalahan si Abaddun, wey ka ngaran din te Grigu ne linalahan si Apulyun, ne ka igpasabut kayi, “Ka Talagdereet.”

7 [xr]The locusts were_like horses that prepared for (LIT in_order_to) fight and they were crowned with (something) like gold, and their faces were_like the faces of people. 8 [xr]And their hair was long like the hair of a woman and their teeth were_like the teeth of a lion. 9 [xr]And there_was (something) protecting their chests like iron, and the noise of their wings was like the noise of many carts pulled by horses galloping towards the fighting_place. 10 And they had power on their tail(s) like the tail of a scorpion with a sting, and they used this for persecuting the people for (LIT inside) five months. 11 And there_was a king that ruled them which was the angel (LIT entrusted (one)) who had authority over the pit without ending. His name in Hibruwanon language was Abaddun, and his name in Greek language was Apulyun, and the meaning of this is, “The Destroyer.”

12 Neimpusan e ka an-anayan ne makaaldek-haldek ne pegbayad-bayad piru duen pad daruwa ne egginguma ne makaaldek-haldek ne me pegbayad-bayad.

12 The first horrifying persecution was_finished but there were still two horrifying persecutions to come.

13 [xr]Ne imparahing e te igkeem-em ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, wey due narineg ku ne laheng ne migpuun te hep-at ne pikungan te altar ne bulawan ne diye te tangkaan te Manama. 14 Ne migkahiyan te laheng ka igkeen-em ne panalihan ne due trumpita, “Lekei nu ka hep-at ne panalihan ne imbaku diye te pagpahamayan ne Weyig ne Iyupratis!” 15 Purisu miglekaan e ka hep-at ne panalihan ne natahahe e te uras, te aldew, te bulan wey te leg-un eyew te pegpangimatey te igkatelu ne baad te keet-etawan. 16 Ne innangenan a ne daruwa ne gatus ne milyun (200,000,000) ka kasuluhan te me sundalu ran ne nangukudde. 17 Ne iling kayi ka ulaula te impakita keddi ne me kudde wey te migmangudde kayi: ka migmangudde due putew ne dingding te me kumeng dan ne malalab ka batek iling te hapuy, wey meilem iling te mahal ne batu ne sapiru, wey makalawag iling te asupri. Ne ka ulu te me kudde egpekeiling te ulu te liyun wey miglihawang puun te me be-be dan ka hapuy, ebel wey asupri. 18 Ne migpatey ka igkatelu ne baad te me etew puun te seini se mangune-kune ne salerep ne iyan ka hapuy, ka ebel wey ka asupri ne eglihawang puun te be-be te me kudde. 19 Su diye te be-be wey te ikug te me kudde ka geem dan; ne ka me ikug dan due me ulu iling te uled wey seini ka eggamiten dan te pegpangahat te me etew.

13 [xr]And the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four corners of the gold altar in front of God. 14 And the voice said to the sixth angel with a trumpet, “Release(sg) the four angels that were bound there at the great/large Iyupratis River!” 15 Therefore the four angels were released that were prepared for the hour, the day, the month and the year in_order_for killing of a third portion of the people. 16 And I was_told that the number of their soldiers on_horses was two hundred million (200,000,000). 17 And the face/appearance of the horses that were revealed to me and the (ones) riding_horses(pl) (were) like this: the (ones) riding_horses(pl) had iron that was colored red like fire protecting their chests, and blue/green like expensive sapiru stones, and yellow like sulfur. And the head(s) of the horses were_like the head of a lion and the fire, smoke and sulfur came from their mouths. 18 And the third portion of the people died from this terrible disaster which was the fire, the smoke and the sulfur that came out of the mouth(s) to the horses. 19 Because their power was in their mouth(s) and tail(s) of the horses; and their tails had heads like a snake and they used them to bite the people.

20 [xr]Ka duma ne me etew ne ware migpatey te seeye ne me salerep, ware mig-inniyug te me maddeet ne me himu ran. Ware sikandan mig-engked te pegpamakey te me busew wey te me diyus-diyus ne kene egpakakita, kene egpakarineg, wey kene egpekeyipanew ne inggimu re puun te bulawan, te pelata, te burunsi, te batu wey te kayu. 21 Ware man-e sikandan mig-inniyug te maddeet ne me himu ran ne pegpangimatey, pegpanlambus, pegpeyilabetey ne kene ne alunggun wey te pegpanakew.

20 [xr]The other people that didn't die(pl) from those disasters, didn't turn_from their evil doings. They didn't stop serving the evil_spirits and false_gods that can't see, can't hear, and can't walk and that are just made from gold, from silver, from bronze, from stone and from wood. 21 They didn't turn_from their evil doings such as killing(pl), sorcery/cursing(pl), sexual_immorality (LIT meddling without being_married) and stealing.

Ka panalihan wey ka deisek ne linulun ne baseen

The angel and the small rolled_up document

101 Nataman, nakakita ad man-e te lein ne panalihan ne maresen ne miglene puun te langit, ne nabukusan te gapun wey neunturan te baluntu ka ulu rin. Ne miglayag ka ulaula rin iling te aldew, wey ka paa rin iling te sungkaleg ne legleg. 2 Ne due inggen-genan din ne deisek ne linulun ne baseen ne nabelat e. Ne diye din iriek te dahat ka kawanan ne paa rin wey diye te tane ka gibang. 3 Ne migpanaman-taman sikandin migpanguleyi iling te liyun ne migteteul. Te napenge e sikandin ka migpanguleyi, migtabak e degma migdagsang ka pitu ne luhung. 4 Te migdagsang e ka pitu ne luhung, igsulat kud e perem ka inlalag dan, piru due narineg ku ne laheng ne migpuun te langit ne miggenendue, “Kene nu iwangal-wangal ka inlalag te pitu ne luhung wey kene nu isulat!”

101 Then, I saw again/also a different powerful (LIT strong) angel that descended from the sky/heaven, wrapped in cloud and a rainbow was on his head. And his face shone like the sun/day, and his feet/leg(s) like a post(s) of flame. 2 And he was holding a small rolled_up document that was spread_out. And he stepped his right foot on the sea and the left on the ground. 3 And he shouted loudly like a lion growling. When he had_finished shouting, the seven thunders answered (by) immediately_sounding. 4 When the seven thunders immediately_sounded, I was about to write what they said, but I heard a voice from the sky/heaven that went, “Keep(sg) it secret (LIT don't talk_openly) (what) the seven thunders said and don't(sg) write (it)!”

5 [xr]Nataman, ka panalihan ne nakita ku ne migsasindeg ne diye migdiek te dahat wey tane, ingkayew rin ka kawanan ne belad din. 6 Ne migsaad sikandin pinaahi te ngaran te ware kapatayan ne Manama ne iyan miggimu te langit, te tane, te dahat wey te langun ne nakatahu kayi. Migkahi ka panalihan, “Kenad egkabanggew ka egkeyitabu keureme. 7 Su te aldew ne igparahing e te igkapitu ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, egkatuman e ka heles ne planu te Manama ne impanengneng din diye te me prupita ne me suluhuanen din.”

5 [xr]Then, the angel that I saw that stood and stepped on the sea and land, raised up his right hand/arm. 6 And he promised by_means of the name of the God without death who made the sky/heaven, the earth, the sea and everything in it/them. And the angel said, “What will_happen in_the_future can't be hindered. 7 Because on the day that the seventh angel sounds his trumpet, the hidden plan of God which he revealed to his servants the prophets will_be_fulfilled.”

8 [xr]Nataman, narineg kud e man-e ka laheng puun te langit ne miggenendue, “Hendiyei nu ka panalihan ne migsasindeg ne diye migdiek te dahat wey te tane wey kua nu ka baseen ne nabelat e ne miggen-genan din.” 9 Ne miggendiyaan kud e ka panalihan, wey imbuyu kud ka deisek ne baseen; ne dutu, ingkahiyan a nikandin, “Kua nu seini wey keena nu; meemis seini iling te teneb ke duen pad te be-be nu, piru egmasakit ka getek nu ke egkaabeleng nud su egmapeit e.” 10 Ne ingkuwa kud e ka deisek ne baseen ne miggen-genan din wey ingkeen kud e. Meemis seini iling te teneb te diye pad te be-be ku piru migmasakit e ka getek ku te naabeleng kud su migmapeit e. 11 Ne due migkahi keddi, “Keilangan ne ig-abey nu igpanagne ka planu te Manama meyitenged te me etew puun te nalein-lein ne me punduk, me nasud wey me linalahan, wey diye te me Hari!”

8 [xr]Then, I again/also heard the voice from the sky/heaven that went, “Go(sg) to the angel that stood and stepped on the sea and the land and take(sg) the rolled_up document that was spread_out that he's holding.” 9 And I went to the angel, and I requested the small document; and then, he said to me, “Take(sg) this and eat(sg) it; this will_be_sweet like honey while it's still in your(sg) mouth, but your(sg) stomach will_be_sore if/when you(sg) swallow it because it becomes bitter.” 10 And I took the small document which he was holding and I ate (it). It was sweet like honey while it was still in my mouth but my stomach hurt when I swallowed it because it turned bitter. 11 And someone told, “You(sg) need again to prophesy the plan of God concerning the people from various groups, nations and languages, and to kings!”

Ka daruwa ne talagpamalehet

The two witnesses

111 [xr]Nataman, due imbehey keddi ne igseked ne iling te tuked wey migkahiyan a, “Sasindeg ka wey sekera nu ka timplu te Manama wey ka altar, wey seela nu ka migmanimba diye. 2 [xr]Piru kene nu sekera ka lihawangan te timplu su imbehey e sika diye te ware migmalintutuu.[fn] Ne eg-ahawen[fn] dan ka Matulus ne Siyudad seled te hep-at ne pulu wey daruwa (42) ne bulan. 3 Ne egsuhuen ku ka daruwa ne talagpamalehet ku eyew egpamalehet meyitenged keddiey. Egsaluub sikandan te saku[fn] wey igpangguhud dan ka igpahuhud ku kandan seled te 1,260 ne aldew.”

111 [xr]Then, (someone) gave me a measuring_stick like a walking stick and I was_told, “Stand_up(sg) and measure(sg) the temple of God and the altar, and count(sg) those worshiping there. 2 [xr]But don't measure(sg) the outside of the temple because that's been_given to non-believers.[fn] And they will_snatch[fn] the Holy City for (LIT inside) forty-two (42) months. 3 And I will_send (LIT command) my two witnesses to witness about me. They will_dress in sack[fn] and they will_story/tell what_ I _will_cause_ them _to_story/tell for (LIT inside) 1,260 days.”

4 [xr]Sikandan seeye se daruwa ne kayu ne ulibu wey ka daruwa ne tahuanan te sulu ne diye migsasindeg te tangkaan te Magbebaye te kalibutan. 5 Ke due egkeupian ne egdereet kandan, due eglihawang ne hapuy diye te me be-be dan ne egpakatutung te me kuntere dan; wey sika ka egpakapatey te egkeupian ne egdereet kandan. 6 [xra][xrb][xrc]Due geem dan te peg-elet te langit eyew kene eg-uran te timpu ne egpangguhud sikandan te igpahuhud ku kandan. Ne due man-e geem dan te peggimu te me weyig ne langesa wey te pegbayad-bayad te me etew diye te kalibutan pinaahi te me salerep te minsan ken-u ran igkeupii.

4 [xr]They (are) the two olive trees and the two lamp holders that stand in front of the Lord of the world. 5 If anyone wants to ruin/destroy them, fire will_come from their mouths that will_burn their enemies; and that is able_to_kill (those) who want to ruin/destroy them. 6 [xra][xrb][xrc]They have power to block the sky/heaven so_that it won't rain at the time when they story/tell what_ I _will_cause_ them _to_story/tell. And they also have power to make the waters/rivers into blood and for persecuting the people in the world by_means of disaster whenever they want.

7 [xra][xrb]Te egpekeimpus e sikandan ka egpangguhud te igpahuhud ku kandan, due eglepew ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap puun te bitu ne ware tamanan ne egpakig-ehet kandan. Egkatalu rin wey egkapatey ka daruwa ne talagpamalehet. 8 [xr]Ne diye de sikandan egpakabahed te dalan te dakel ne siyudad ne inlansangan te Magbebaye dan. Ka seeye ne siyudad impahunsilingan te Suduma wey Ihiptu. 9 Ne dutun de iya egpakatahu ka me lawa ran seled te tatelu ne aldew wey liware, wey egpipitawen te me etew ne namuun te nalein-lein ne me punduk, me tribu wey me linalahan, wey me nasud. Ne kene sikandan eg-uyun ne iglebeng ka lawa ran. 10 Eggale-gale ka me etew te kalibutan wey egsahakeen wey egpabegbehayey te dasag tenged te pegpatey te daruwa ne talagpamalehet ne migbayad-bayad te me etew ne nangugpe te kalibutan. 11 [xr]Piru te peglihad te tatelu ne aldew wey liware, in-uyag ded sikandan te Manama. Nanasindeg sikandan wey amana nenaaldek seeye se nakakita kandan. 12 [xr]Nataman, nakarineg ka daruwa ne talagpamalehet te heemeni ne laheng ne egpuun te langit ne migkahi, “Pamaneyik kew kayi!” Ne imbatun e sikandan te gapun taheed te migmanetengteng ka me kuntere dan. 13 [xr]Te sikan de iya, miglilinug te amana ne nenekali wey nalundus ka igkasapulu ne baad te siyudad wey due pitu ne libu (7,000) ne etew ne migpatey. Puun due, amana ne nenaaldek ka me etew ne nasame wey indayan dan ka Manama ne diye te langit.

7 [xra][xrb]When they finish storying/telling what_ I _will_cause_ them _to_story/tell, a terrifying animal from the pit without ending will_appear to attack them. The two witnesses will_be_defeated and killed by him/her/it. 8 [xr]And they will_lie_dead on the path of the big city where their Lord was crucified (LIT nailed). That city is illustrated_by Suduma and Ihiptu. 9 And their bodies will_remain (LIT put) there for (LIT inside) three days and a half, and they will_be_looked_at by the people from different groups, tribes and languages, and nations. And they won't agree that their body(s) be buried. 10 The people of the world will_rejoice and feast and give_each_other gifts due to the dying of the two witnesses who persecuted the people that live in the world. 11 [xr]But after three and a half days passed, God made_ them _alive. They stood(pl) and those who saw them were very afraid(pl). 12 [xr]Then, the two witnesses heard a very_loud voice from the sky/heaven that said, “Come_up(pl) here!” And they ascended by cloud(s) while their enemies watched(pl). 13 [xr]Just at that (moment), it earthquaked very strongly and a tenth portion of the city collapsed and there were seven thousand (7,000) people that died. From that, the remaining people were very afraid and they praised God in heaven/sky.

14 Neimpusan e ka igkarangeb ne makaaldek-haldek ne pegbayad-bayad piru mahaan e egginguma ka igkatelu.

14 The second horrifying persecution was_finished but the third was already close.

Ka igkapitu ne trumpita

The seventh trumpet

15 [xr]Nataman, imparahing e te igkapitu ne panalihan ka trumpita rin, wey due migpanaman-taman migmanguleyi diye te langit ne migkahi, “Egharian e kuntee te Manama ka kalibutan duma ki Kristu ne in-alam din, wey eghari sikandin te ware egtamanan!” 16 Ne nangusengul wey migsimba te Manama ka daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at (24) ne me igbuyag ne naminnuu te me trunu ran ne diye te egkatangkaan te Manama. 17 Migkahi sikandan,

15 [xr]Then, the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were shouted(pl) loudly from the sky/heaven that said, “God will_ now _reign_over the world along_with Christ he has chosen, and he will_reign without ending!” 16 And the twenty-four (24) elders that sit(pl) of their thrones in front of God bowed_their_face_to_the_ground and worshiped God. 17 They said,

“Migpasalamat key keykew Magbebaye ne Maresen ne Manama,

“We(excl) thank you(sg) Lord Powerful God,

ne iyan ka Manama dengan wey ka Manama kuntee;

who is the God before and the God now;

su inggamit nu ka dakel ne geem nu

because you(sg) used your(sg) great power

wey imbunsuran nud e ka peghari nu!

and you(sg) started your(sg) reigning!

18 [xra][xrb]Nabbelu ka me etew ne ware migmalintutuu keykew,

18 [xra][xrb]The people were angry(pl) who didn't believe you(sg),

piru miggingume e ka timpu te langet nu

but the time came for your(sg) anger

wey ka timpu te peggukum nu te nammatey.

and the time for your(sg) judging to the dead.

Miggingume e degma ka timpu ne egdasahan nud ka me suluhuanen nu, ka me prupita,

The time also came that you(sg) will_give_gifts to your(sg) servants, the prophets,

wey ka keet-etawan nu, wey ka langun ne migtahud keykew,

and your(sg) people, and all who respect you(sg),
