honored or not.

Seinid e ka timpu ne egdereetan nud ka me talagdereet te nangugpe te kalibutan!”

This is the time that you(sg) will_ruin/destroy the ruiners/destroyers of the (ones who) live in the world!”

19 [xra][xrb]Nataman, nalukatan e ka timplu te Manama ne diye te langit wey nakite e ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama ne diye te seled te timplu rin. Ne dutu, miggeteb e ka kilat wey due migderaheneg, wey migdagsang e ka luhung wey miglilinug e, wey mig-uran e te derakel ne apiyew.

19 [xra][xrb]Then, the temple of God in the sky/heaven was_opened and the Container of the Agreement of God could be seen inside his temple. And then, the lightning flashed and there_was a_booming_sound, and the thunder sounded_immediately and it earthquaked, and it rained large hail(stones).

Ka malitan wey ka salimbaweng

The woman and the monster

121 Nataman, due amana ne kein-inuwan ne egkiteen diye te langit. Su due malitan ne migsaluub te aldew wey diye migsasindeg te bulan, wey migkukuruna sikandin te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne bituen. 2 Naberes sikandin wey mahaan e eglesuti, sikan naa ka migpanguleyi sikandin su egbaletikan e.

121 Then, there_was a very amazing wonder that can be seen in the sky/heaven. For there_was a woman dressed in the sun and standing on the moon, and she was crowned with twelve (12) stars. 2 She was pregnant and close to giving_birth, that's why she shouted because (she) was already having_labor_pains.

3 [xr]Ne duen e man-e lein ne kein-inuwan ne egkiteen diye te langit: due bubuyahen ne salimbaweng ne malalab ne pitu ka ulu wey sapulu ka sungey, wey ka tagse ulu due kuruna. 4 [xr]Ne ingkeyis din te ikug din ka igkatelu ne baad te me bituen wey indegpak din diye te tane. Ne diyad migsasindeg ka salimbaweng te tangkaan te malitan ne mahaan e eglesuti eyew egsagmaken din ka bate ke eglesut e. 5 [xra][xrb]Nataman, te miglesutan e ka malitan te lukes ne bate ne iyan egmandu te me nasud ne ware keyid-u te me kuntere din,[fn] due migsalukagmit te bate wey in-uyan e peendiye te Manama diye te trunu rin. 6 Ne migpallahuy e ka malitan diye te disirtu, ne iyan ka intahahe te Manama ne egpaaputan kandin eyew diye egtangguwa seled te 1,260 ne aldew.

3 [xr]And there_was also another sign revealed in the sky/heaven: there_was an enormous red monster with seven heads and ten horns, and each head had a crown. 4 [xr]And it swept_aside a third portion of the stars with its tail and it threw them to the ground. And the monster stood in front of the woman soon to give_birth so_that it could devour the child if/when it was_born. 5 [xra][xrb]Then, when the male child was_born who would rule_over the nations without sympathy for his enemies,[fn] (something/someone) snatched the child and took it to God on his throne. 6 And the woman ran to desert, which had been_prepared by God as a place_ for her _to_flee_to in_order to be looked_after for (LIT inside) 1,260 days.

7 [xr]Nataman, due gubut diye te langit su migpabunbunuey si Mikail duma te me panalihan din wey te salimbaweng duma te me panalihan din degma. 8 Piru natalu ka salimbaweng duma te me panalihan din, wey warad tuhuti te Manama ne eg-ugpe dan diye te langit. 9 [xra][xrb]Ne indegpak e diye te tane ka bubuyahen ne salimbaweng. Sikandin ka tapey ne uled ne egngaranan ki Meibulan, ka ahalen te me busew ne iyan miglimbung te me etew kayi te ampew te tane. Indegpak sikandin diye te tane duma te me panalihan din.

7 [xr]Then, there_was a fight/war in the sky/heaven because Mikail along_with his angels and the monster also along_with his angels fought_each_other. 8 But the monster lost along_with his angels, and they were no_longer permitted by God to live there in heaven/sky. 9 [xra][xrb]And the enormous monster was thrown to the ground. He (was) the ancient snake named Satan (MS Meibulan), the master of the evil_spirits who cheated the people here on the top of the ground. He was thrown to the ground along_with his angels.

10 [xr]Ne due narineg ku ne migpanaman-taman migpanguleyi diye te langit ne miggenendue, “Timpu e ne egluwasen e te Manama ka me etew. Igpapitew rin e ka geem din te peghari wey ka katenged te Kristu ne in-alam din. Su ka diye te tangkaan te Manama ne talagsumbung te me suled ta te aldew wey marusilem, indegpak e diye te tane. 11 Natalu ran sikandin pinaahi te langesa te impanubad ne Nati ne Karniru wey te pinaahi degma te kamalehetan ne inwali ran. Ne ware dan ikannuhun ka umul ran minsan pad egpatey sikandan tenged te pegpalintutuu ran. 12 Ne tenged due, gale-gale kew ka nangugpe te langit.[fn] Piru mekeyid-u-hid-u kew ka due te tane wey dahat[fn] su miglene e due te kaniyu ka ahalen te me busew ne amana ne nalanglangetan, su nakataha rin ne kene naan de sikandin egkaluhey!”

10 [xr]And I heard shouted loudly from the sky/heaven that went, “It's now the time that God will_save the people. He will_show his power for reigning and the authority of Christ who he chose. For the (one who) is in front of God who is accusing our(incl) siblings/friends in day and night, was thrown to the ground. 11 They defeated him by_means of blood of the sacrificed Lamb and also by_means of the truth that they preached. And they weren't possessive of their live(s) even though they died for their believing. 12 And due to that, be happy you(pl) who are living in heaven/sky.[fn] But the (one/ones) on earth and in the sea[fn] are to be pitied because the master of the evil_spirits has descended on you(pl) being very angry, because he knows that he won't have long!”

13 Te nasahimanu e te salimbaweng ne indegpak e sikandin diye te tane, inlupug din e ka malitan ne mig-anak te lukes. 14 [xr]Piru imbehayan ka malitan te daruwa ne pakpak te dakel ne banug eyew egpakalayang sikandin peendiye te disirtu ne egtangguwan kandin te 1,260 ne aldew, wey eyew egpakapariyu sikandin te salimbaweng. 15 Ne migkulepe e ka salimbaweng te dakel ne weyig ne impasinundul rin te malitan eyew egkaanlas sikandin. 16 Piru imbulihan te tane ka malitan. Migbekabeka ka tane wey migleneb e ka weyig ne ingkulepa te salimbaweng. 17 Nabelu-belu ka salimbaweng te malitan wey miggipanew e sikandin ka egpakig-ehet te duma pad ne me kabuhalan te malitan. Sikandan seeye se migtuman te me suhu te Manama wey te kamalehetan ne impanulu ni Hisus. 18 Ne diye migsasindeg ka salimbaweng te ilis te dahat.

13 When the monster discovered that he was thrown to the ground, he chased the woman who had borne a male. 14 [xr]But the woman was_given two wings of a large eagle so_that she could fly to the desert where she would_be_looked_after for (LIT inside) 1,260 days, and so_that she could_distance (herself) from the monster. 15 And the monster spat_out a lot of water that he caused_to_follow the woman so_that she would_be_washed_downstream. 16 But the woman was_helped by the ground. The ground cracked_open and the water spat_out by the monster was absorbed. 17 The monster was_ very _angry at the woman and he went to attack other descendants of the woman. They are those who obeyed the commands of God and the truth taught by Jesus. 18 And the monster stood there at the edge of the sea.

Ka daruwa ne mananap ne makaliyas-liyas

The two terrifying animals

131 [xra][xrb]Nataman, due nakita ku ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap ne miglepew puun te dahat. Due sapulu ne sungey kayi wey pitu ne ulu, ne ka tagse sungey due kuruna. Ne ka tagse ulu impanulatan te me ngaran ne egpakabaley-baley te Manama. 2 [xr]Ne ka nakita ku ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap egpekeiling te liyupardu, ka me paa rin egpekeiling te paa te usu, wey ka be-be din egpekeiling te be-be te liyun. Ne imbehey e te salimbaweng diye te mananap ka geem din, ka trunu rin, wey ka dakel ne katenged din te pegmandu. 3 Ka sabeka ne ulu te mananap due bateg te bubuyahen ne pali ne egpakapatey, piru neulian ded. Neinu-inu te mananap ka me etew te intiru ne kalibutan wey mig-ikul sikandan kandin. 4 Insimba te me etew ka salimbaweng su imbehey rin ka katenged din diye te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap. Ne insimba ran degma ka mananap te migkahi, “Hentew naan de iya ka egpekeiling te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap? Hentew naan de iya ka egpakaatu kandin?”

131 [xra][xrb]Then, there_was a terrifying animal I saw that appeared from the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, and each horn had a crown. Each head had names which blaspheme God written_on_it. 2 [xr]And the terrifying animal which I saw was like a leopard (BORROWED liyupardu), his feet/legs were_like the feet/legs of a bear (BORROWED usu), and his mouth was like the mouth of a lion (BORROWED liyun). And the monster gave his power, his throne, and his big authority for ruling to the animal. 3 One head of the animal has the scar of an enormous fatal wound, but it was healed. The people from the entire world were amazed at the animal and they followed him. 4 The monster was worshiped by the people because he gave his authority to the terrifying animal. And they also worshiped the animal saying, “Who can indeed be like the terrifying animal? Who can indeed fight_against him?”

5 [xr]Intuhutan ka mananap te pegpaambug wey te pegbaley-baley te Manama, wey intuhutan degma sikandin te pegmandu seled te hep-at ne pulu wey daruwa (42) ne bulan. 6 Sikan naa, migpanlalag e ka mananap te pegbaley-baley te Manama, te pegbaley-baley te ngaran din wey te ugpaan din, wey te langun ne nangugpe diye te langit.[fn] 7 [xr]Intuhutan sikandin ne egpakig-ehet te keet-etawan te Manama wey te pegtalu kandan. Imbehayan man-e sikandin te katenged te pegmandu te me etew ne namuun te nalein-lein ne me tribu, me punduk wey me linalahan, wey me nasud. 8 [xr]Ne egsimba kandin ka langun ne nangugpe te kalibutan, angin e te seeye se nakasulat se me ngaran diye te Libru te Umul. Te ware pad neyimu ka kalibutan, nakasulat e ka me ngaran dan diye te libru te Nati ne Karniru ne innimatayan.

5 [xr]The animal was allowed to be proud and to blaspheme God, and also (it) was allowed to rule for (LIT inside) forty-two (42) months. 6 So then, the animal spoke(pl) blaspheming God, blaspheming his name and his living_place, and all that live(pl) in heaven/sky.[fn] 7 [xr]It was allowed to fight with the people of God and to defeat them. He was also given authority for ruling the people from different tribes, groups and languages, and nations. 8 [xr]And all that lived(pl) in the world worshiped it, except those whose names were_written in the Book of Life. Before the world was created, their names were_written in the book of the Lamb that was_killed.

9 “Purisu, ke egkeupian ka ne egpakasabut, sumsumana nu ay-ayari ke nekey ka narineg nu![fn] 10 [xr]Ka minsan hentew ne iyan egkeyingumaan ka egkarakep, egdakepen iya wey ka minsan hentew ne iyan egkeyingumaan ka eggimatayan pinaahi te kampilan, eggimatayan iya pinaahi te kampilan. Purisu, keilangan ne egpakannekal wey eg-antus te me keyirapan ka keet-etawan te Manama.”

9 “Therefore, if you(sg) want to understand, think carefully about what you(sg) heard![fn] 10 [xr]Whoever's destiny is to be captured, will_ indeed _be_captured and whoever's destiny is to be_killed by the sword, will_ indeed _be_killed by the sword. Therefore, it's_necessary that the people of God strive and suffer/persevere difficulties.”

11 Nataman, duen e man-e nakita ku ne lein ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap ne miglepew puun te tane. Due daruwa ne sungey rin ne egpekeiling te sungey te nati ne karniru, wey hendue te salimbaweng ke eglalag. 12 Inggamit din ka langun ne katenged te an-anayan ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap diye te tangkaan kayi wey impehes din ka langun ne nangugpe te kalibutan ne egsimba te an-anayan ne mananap ne due bateg te dakel ne pali ne egpakapatey, piru neulian ded. 13 Ne seeye se ikarangeb ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap, amana ne kein-inuwan ka immangimu rin su nakapeuran sikandin te hapuy diye te tangkaan te me etew. 14 Nalimbungan te ikarangeb ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap ka nangugpe te kalibutan pinaahi te me kein-inuwan ne intuhut kandin ne eggimuwen diye tangkaan te an-anayan ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap. Ne insuhu din ka me etew ne eggimu te larawan te an-anayan ne mananap ne napalian te kampilan piru neuyag ded. 15 Intuhutan sikandin ne egpepaheyinaween din ka larawan te an-anayan ne makaliyas-liyas ne mananap su eyew egpakalalag wey egpeyimatey te kene egsimba kandin. 16 Impehes din man-e ka langun ne etew, mabantug wey se kene, meyaman wey se egkaayu-ayu, uripen wey se kene, ne egkulitan diye te kawanan ne belad dan wey ke diye naa te buked dan. 17 Ne ware minsan hentew ne egpakabebeli wey ke egpakabebelegye angin e te seeye se due kulit te ngaran te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap wey ke numiru te ngaran din.

11 Then, there_was another terrifying animal that I also/again saw appeared from the ground. He had two horns like the horns of a lamb, and spoke like a monster. 12 It used all the authority of the first terrifying animal in front of it and he persuaded all that live(pl) in the world to worship the first animal that has a scar from a large wound that could_kill, but was healed. 13 And that second terrifying animal, the signs that he did were very amazing because it caused_rain of fire (from the sky/heaven) in front of the people. 14 Those who live(pl) in the world were cheated/deceived by the second terrifying animal by_means of the amazing_things that it was permitted to do in front of the first terrifying animal. And it commanded the people to make an image of the first animal that was_wounded with a sword but alive still. 15 It was permitted to give_breath to the image of the first terrifying animal so_that it could_speak and cause_ (those who) don't worship it _to_be_killed. 16 It again/also persuaded/forced all the people, honored or not, wealthy or poor, slave or not, to be marked on their right hand/arm or on their forehead. 17 And no_(one) could_buy or could_sell except those who had a mark with the name of the terrifying animal or the number of his name.

18 Keilangan te katuenan ka pegsabut kayi. Ne ka due katuenan te pegsabut keilangan ne egnengnengan din ke nekey ka kaluwasan te numiru te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap su palinneu seini te ngaran te etew. Ne ka numiru iyan ka 666.

18 It needs knowledge to understand this. And the (one) with knowledge for understanding needs to know what is the meaning of the number of the terrifying animal because this is a signal of the name of a person. And the number is 666.

Ka Nati ne Karniru wey ka 144,000 ne keet-etawan

The Lamb and the 144,000 people

141 [xr]Nataman, nakita ku ka Nati ne Karniru ne migsasindeg diye te Bubungan ne Siyun[fn] duma te sabeka ne gatus wey hep-at ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (144,000) ne keet-etawan ne nasulatan ka me buked te ngaran te Nati ne Karniru wey te Amey rin. 2 Ne nakarineg a te laheng puun te langit ne egpekeiling te lehes te dakel ne sampew, wey iling karahing te dagsang te luhung, wey egpekeiling man-e te dahing te impangelit ne me alpa. 3 Ne nangulahing sikandan te iyam ne ulahingen diye te tangkaan te trunu wey diye te hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa wey te me igbuyag. Ware lein ne nateu te seeye ne ulahingen angin e te seeye se sabeka ne gatus wey hep-at ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (144,000) ne me etew ne inlekat puun te kalibutan. 4 Sikandan ka me etew ne ware nekewulid te me malitan wey sikandan ka migsinundul te Nati ne Karniru minsan hendei sikandin eggendiye. Sikandan ka linekat ne me keet-etawan puun diye te kalibutan wey sikandan ka in-uhab diye te Manama wey te Nati ne Karniru. 5 [xr]Warad iya sikandan nanguubat wey warad iya igkarew-ey kandan.

141 [xr]Then, I saw the Lamb that stood on Mount Siyun[fn] along_with one hundred and forty-four thousand (144,000) people with the name of the Lamb and of his Father written on (their) foreheads. 2 And I heard a voice from the sky/heaven like the noise of great/large waterfall, and like the sound of a clap of thunder, and also like the sound of plucked of harps. 3 And they sang(pl) a new song in front of the throne and of the four breathing creatures and of the elders. No (one) else knew that song except for those/that one hundred and forty-four thousand (144,000) people that were redeemed from the world. 4 They (are) the people who haven't slept with women and they followed the Lamb wherever he goes. They (are) the people redeemed from the world and they (are) the first_fruits_offered to God and of the Lamb. 5 [xr]They never lied(pl) and there_is_nothing to scold them for.

Ka tatelu ne panalihan

The three angels

6 Nataman, due nakita ku ne lein ne panalihan ne miglayang diye te aw-awangan ne mig-uyan te Meupiya ne Panugtulen ne kene egkabalbalawan te ware egtamanan. Igwali seeye diye te kalibutan, diye te me etew ne namuun te nalein-lein ne me nasud, me tribu wey me linalahan, wey me punduk. 7 Ne migpanaman-taman sikandin migpanguleyi ne migkahi, “Kaaldeki niyu ka Manama wey dayana niyu sikandin, tenged su miggingume e ka timpu te peggukum din. Ne simbaa niyu ka miggimu te langit wey te tane, te dahat wey te me sebseb te me weyig.”

6 Then, I saw another angel that flew in the atmosphere that carried the Good Report that can never be changed forever. That will_be_preached to the world, to the people from various nations, tribes and languages, and groups. 7 And he shouted loudly saying, “Fear(pl) God and praise(pl) him, because the time has come for his judging. And worship(pl) the (one who) made the sky/heaven and the earth, the sea and the springs of waters.”

8 [xr]Ne due nakasinundul ne igkarangeb ne panalihan ne migkahi, “Nahuhus e! Nahuhus e ka Mabantug ne Babilunya! Su impeinum din ka langun ne nasud te binu ne iyan ka agkey rin!”

8 [xr]And there_was following second angel saying, “It's destroyed! The Honored Babilunya is destroyed! Because it caused_ all nations _to_drink wine which was her lust!”

9 Ne due nakasinundul kandan ne igkatelu ne panalihan wey migpanaman-taman migpanguleyi ne migkahi, “Ka minsan hentew ne egsimba te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap wey te larawan din wey egpakulit diye te buked din wey ke diye naa te belad din, 10 [xra][xrb]egpekeinum degma sikandin te telek ne binu te Manama ne in-itis diye te ubab te langet din. Ne egbaybayaran sikandin pinaahi te hapuy wey asupri diye te tangkaan te matulus ne me panalihan wey te tangkaan te Nati ne Karniru. 11 [xr]Ne egparibabew te ware egtamanan ka ebel puun te igbayad-bayad kandan. Kene egpekeyimeley ne egkabaybayaran te aldew wey marusilem seeye se migsimba te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap wey te larawan, wey migpakulit te ngaran te mananap. 12 Purisu ka keet-etawan te Manama ne migtuman te me suhu din wey migsalig ki Hisus, keilangan ne egpabulus ka egpalintutuu.”

9 And there_was a third angel that following them and loudly shouted saying, “Whoever worships the terrifying animal and his image and gets_marked on his forehead or on his hand/arm, 10 [xra][xrb]will_ also _drink of the pure wine of God poured into a cup of his anger. And he will_be_persecuted by fire and sulfur in front of the holy angels and in front of the Lamb. 11 [xr]And the smoke from his persecuting them will_rise without ending. And those who worshiped the terrifying animal and the image, and got_marked with the name of the animal can't have rest from persecution day and night. 12 Therefore the people of God who obey his commands and trust in Jesus, need to continue to believe/have_faith.”

13 Nataman, due narineg ku ne laheng puun te langit ne migkahi, “Isulat nu seini: Puun kuntee, keupianan te seeye se nammatey ne due te Magbebaye!”

13 Then, I heard a voice from heaven/sky that said, “Write(sg) this: From now (on), well_being to those who died in the Lord!”

Ne migtabak ka Panisingan te Manama, “Malehet iya. Egpanalanginan sikandan eyew egpekeyimeley e te me keyirapan, su eglibed diye te kandan ka meupiya ne hinimuwan dan.[fn]”

And the Spirit of God answered, “Correct indeed. They will_be_blessed so_that (they) can_rest from difficulties, because their good deeds will_return to them.[fn]”

Ka peggaani te kalibutan

The harvesting of the world

14 [xr]Nataman, due nakita ku ne maangkag ne gapun ne due migpinnuu ne hendue te anak te etew ne migkukuruna te bulawan wey miggen-gen te mahalang ne galab. 15 [xr]Ne due nakita ku ne lein ne panalihan ne miglihawang te timplu wey migpanaman-tamanan din kuleyii ka migpinpinnuu te gapun te migkahi, “Ay-ayuna nud ka galab nu wey gaani kad su neyinuhan e ka eggaaniyen diye te kalibutan!” 16 Purisu inggalab e te seeye se migpinnuu te gapun ka eggaaniyen, wey nahaaniyan e ka kalibutan.

14 [xr]Then, there_was a white cloud I saw and (something) like the child of people sat there crowned in gold and holding a sharp sickle. 15 [xr]And I saw a different angel who came_from the temple and shouted loudly to the (one) sitting on the cloud and said, “Use(sg) your(sg) sickle and harvest because the harvest_place in the world is ripe!” 16 Therefore that (one) who sat on the cloud cut the harvest_field, and the world was harvested.

17 Nataman, due nakita ku ne lein ne panalihan ne miglihawang te timplu diye te langit wey due degma galab din ne mahalang.

17 Then, there_was another angel that I saw came_from the temple in the sky/heaven and he also had a sharp sickle.

18 Ne duen e man-e nakita ku ne lein ne panalihan ne migpuun te altar ne iyan impiyalan te hapuy. Migpanaman-tamanan din kuleyii ka due mahalang ne galab ne migkahi, “Ay-ayuna nud ka galab nu wey panlegtasa nud ka me pungpung te me behas te paras diye te kalibutan su neneyinuhan e!” 19 Purisu impanlegtas e te panalihan ka me behas te paras diye te kalibutan wey impangantug din e diye te maluag ne kelesanan te langet te Manama. 20 [xr]Ne ingkeles e ka me behas diye te kelesanan ne diye te lihawangan te siyudad. Ne puun te kelesanan due langesa ne migtulayas ne taman te bake te kudde ka karalem wey tatelu ne gatus (300) ne kilumitru ka kalayatan.

18 And there_was again another angel entrusted with fire that I saw exited from the altar. It shouted loudly to the (one who) has a sharp sickle and said, “Use(sg) your(sg) sickle and cut_off(sg) the bunches of grapevine fruits in the world because it's ripe!” 19 Therefore the angel cut_off the fruits of the grapevine in the world and threw_ them _underarm to the wide squeezer of the anger of God. 20 [xr]And the fruits was squeezed in the squeezer outside the city. And from the squeezer blood streamed_out until its depth was the chin of a horse and the length was three hundred (300) kilometers.

Ka me panalihan ne mig-uyan te katammanan ne me salerep

The angels that brought the final disasters

151 Ne duen e man-e nakita ku ne amana ne kein-inuwan diye te langit. Due pitu ne panalihan ne mig-uyan te pitu ne salerep. Katammanan seini ne me salerep su dutun de egkataman kandan ka langet te Manama.

151 And I again/also saw a very amazing sign in the sky/heaven. There were seven angels carrying seven disasters. These were the final disasters because the anger of God was only as far as them.

2 Ne due nakita ku ne hendue te dahat ne bildu ne amana ne mating-ew ne nasewuhan te hapuy. Ne nakita ku ne diye nanasindeg te ilis dutu ka nenakapanalu te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap wey te larawan din wey ware nakuliti te numiru te ngaran din. Nanguyan sikandan te me alpa ne imbehey te Manama 3 [xr]wey nangulahing te ulahingen ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Manama, wey te ulahingen te Nati ne Karniru ne eggenendue:

2 And there_was I saw (something) like a sea of glass that was transparent and mixed with fire. And I saw standing(pl) on the edge of it those who had defeated the terrifying animal and his image and did not caused-(themselves)_to_be_marked with the number of his name. They carried(pl) harps that were_given by God 3 [xr]and (they) sang(pl) the song by Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb that goes:

“Dakel wey kein-inuwan ka me himu nu

“Your(sg) works are great and amazing

maresen ne Magbebaye ne Manama!

powerful Lord God!

Matareng wey eleg ka me paahi nu

Your(sg) ways are righteous and correct

Hari te langun ne me nasud!

king of all nations!

4 [xra][xrb]Hentew buwa ka kene egkaaldek keykew Magbebaye,

4 [xra][xrb]Who is not afraid of you(sg) Lord,

wey kene egsaye te ngaran nu?

and doesn't praise your(sg) name?

Su sikeykew re ka matulus.

Because only you(sg) (are) holy.

Eggendue te keykew ka me etew te langun ne me nasud wey egsimba keykew,

The people of all nations go to you(sg) and worship you(sg),

tenged su nanengnengan e ka matareng ne me himu nu.”

because your(sg) righteous acts are known.”

5 [xr]Pegkapenga dutu, nakita ku ne nalukatan ka timplu diye te langit ne iyan ka balungbalung te Manama. 6 Ne miglihawang puun te timplu ka pitu ne panalihan ne mig-uyan te pitu ne salerep. Nangukumbale sikandan te maangkag ne hinabel ne masil-ew wey nanlelamben te tabed ne bulawan. 7 Ka sabeka te hep-at ne hinimuwan ne eggeheyinawa, migbehayan din ka me panalihan te pitu ne yahung ne bulawan ne napenu te langet te ware kapatayan ne Manama. 8 [xr]Ne napenu e ka timplu te ebel ne egpuun te katelesen te Manama wey te geem din. Ne ware egpakaseled dutu taman te egkeimpusan e ka pitu ne salerep ne in-uyan te pitu ne panalihan.

5 [xr]When that was_finished, I saw that the temple in heaven which is the tent of God was_opened. 6 And the seven angels that carried seven disasters exited from the temple. They were dressed(pl) in white cloth that was shiny and wrapped_around_the_chest with a gold girdle. 7 And one of the four breathing creatures, he gave seven gold bowls to the angels full of the anger of the God without death. 8 [xr]And the temple was filled with smoke from the splendor of God and (from) his power. And no_(one) could enter there until the seven disasters were finished that were carried by the seven angels.

Ka me yahung ne intahuan te langet te Manama

The bowls filled with the anger of God

161 Nataman, due narineg ku ne heemeni ne laheng ne diye egpuun te timplu. Migpakiglalag seini diye te pitu ne panalihan ne migkahi: “Hipanew kew e wey ibusbus niyud diye te kalibutan ka pitu ne yahung ne langet te Manama!”

161 Then, I heard a very_loud voice from the temple. It spoke to the seven angels saying: “Go(pl) and pour(pl) the seven bowls of the anger of God onto the world!”

2 [xr]Ne mig-ayun e ka an-anayan ne panalihan wey imbusbus din e ka tahu te yahung din diye te kalibutan. Ne dutu, nangehang e te susumpiti ka me etew ne migpakulit te kulit te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap wey migsimba te larawan din.

2 [xr]And the first angel went and poured the contents of his bowl on the world. And then, the people who had got_marked with the mark of the terrifying animal and (who) worshiped his image got_ very_awful _sores.

3 Ne imbusbus e te ikarangeb ne panalihan ka tahu te yahung din diye te dahat. Ne migbaluy e ka dahat ne langesa iling te langesa te minatey, wey nammatey ka langun ne miggeheyinawa diye te dahat.

3 And the second angel poured out the contents of his bowl on the sea. And the sea became blood like the blood of a dead_person, and everything that breathed in the sea died(pl).

4 [xr]Ne imbusbus e degma te igkatelu ne panalihan ka tahu te yahung din diye te me weyig wey diye te me sebseb, wey migbaluy e ka me weyig ne langesa. 5 Ne narineg ku ka panalihan ne migbantey te weyig ne migkahi, “Sikeykew se Sabsabeka ne Matulus ne kayid dengan wey minsan kuntee, matareng ka peglegpad nu. 6 Su impalangesa ran ka me keet-etawan nu minsan ka me prupita, sikan naa ka impeinum nu degma sikandan te langesa. Ne sika iya ka eleg kandan!” 7 Ne nakarineg a te laheng ne migpuun diye te altar ne migkahi, “Malehet iya Magbebaye ne Maresen ne Manama, malehet wey matareng ka me legpad nu!”

4 [xr]And the third angel also poured the contents of his bowl on the rivers/waters and springs, and the waters/rivers became blood. 5 And I heard the angel that guarded the water/river say, “You(sg) (are) who is One_and_only Holy (one) that was here before and even now, your(sg) punishing is righteous. 6 Because they caused_ your(sg) people even the prophets _to_bleed, so then you(sg) have also caused_ them _to_drink blood. And that indeed is correct for them!” 7 Then I heard a voice from the altar that said, “True indeed Lord Powerful God, your(sg) punishing is true and righteous!”

8 Ne imbusbus e te igkeep-at ne panalihan ka tahu te yahung din diye te aldew, wey intuhutan ka aldew ne egmeinit te mangune-kune eyew egkatutung ka me etew te keinit din. 9 Ne natutung ka me etew te mangune-kune ne keinit, wey imbaley-baley ran e ka ngaran te Manama ne iyan impuunan te seeye ne me salerep. Ne ware sikandan mig-inniyug te me sale dan wey ware migsaye kandin.

8 And the fourth angel poured the contents of his bowl on the sun, and permitted the sun to become terribly hot so_that the people would_be_burnt by its heat. 9 And the people were burnt by its terrible heat, and they blasphemed the name of God who was the source of those disasters. And they didn't turn from their sins and didn't praise him.

10 [xr]Ne imbusbus e degma te igkalalimma ne panalihan ka tahu te yahung din diye te trunu te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap. Ne seeye naa, migmarusilem e ka migharian din, wey impangahat e te me etew ka me dile dan tenged te kasakit, 11 wey imbaley-baley ran ka Manama ne diye te langit tenged te kasakit wey te me kehang ne in-antus dan, wey ware sikandan mig-inniyug te maddeet ne hinimuwan dan.

10 [xr]And the fifth angel also poured the contents of his bowl there on the throne of the terrifying animal. And so then, its kingdom became_dark, and the people bit(pl) their tongues due to the pain, 11 and they blasphemed God in heaven/sky due to the pain and sores that they suffered, and they didn't turn from their bad works.

12 [xr]Ne imbusbus e degma te igkeen-em ne panalihan ka tahu te yahung din diye te dakel ne Weyig ne Iyupratis, wey neetiyan e seeye su intahahe ne egpabayaan te me Hari ne egpuun te igsile. 13 Ne due nakita ku ne tatelu ne busew ne egpekeiling te me bakbak. Ka sabeka ne busew miglihawang puun te be-be te salimbaweng, ka sabeka diye miglihawang te be-be te makaliyas-liyas ne mananap wey ka sabeka diye miglihawang te be-be te kene ne malehet ne prupita. 14 Sikandan ka me busew ne miggimu te me kein-inuwan. 5 [xr]Ne due laheng ne migpuun te trunu ne migkahi, “Sikaniyu langun se me suluhuanen din ne migtahud kandin, mabantug ma wey se kene, dayana niyu ka kanta ne Manama!” 6 [xra][xrb]Nataman, nakarineg ad e man-e te laheng ne egpekeiling te guhulubi ne me etew wey egpekeiling man-e te lehes te dakel ne sampew, wey egpekeiling te dahing te kekesehi ne dagsang te luhung. Ka 1,000 ne leg-un

201 Ne due nakita ku ne sabeka ne panalihan ne miglene puun te langit ne mig-uyan te yabi te bitu ne ware tamanan wey te bubuyahen ne keddina. 2 [xr]Ne indakep e te panalihan ka salimbaweng ne iyan ka tapey ne uled ne ahalen te me busew wey ke si Meibulan naa, wey imbaku din e seled te sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne leg-un. 3 Ne in-ulug e te panalihan ka salimbaweng diye te bitu ne ware tamanan, ne inlekeban wey intuusan din e ka bitu eyew kenad e egpakapanlimbung te me nasud taman te eglihad e ka sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne leg-un. Ware neuyag ka duma ne me minatey te ware pad miglihad ka sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne leg-un. 6 Ka pegkalagkes te minsan hentew te an-anayan ne pegkeuyag, egpanalanginan sikandin wey matulus. Kenad e sikandan egpakaneem-neem te ikarangeb ne kamatayen, ke kene, egkeyimu sikandan ne me talagpanubad te Manama wey ni Kristu, wey eghari sikandan duma ki Kristu te sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne leg-un.

4 [xr]Then, there were thrones I saw and the (ones) sitting(pl) on them were_given authority for judging. 15 [xr]Ka panalihan ne migpakiglalag keddiey, due igseked ne bulawan ne in-uyan din eyew igseked te siyudad wey te me gumawan, wey te alad kayi. 16 Hep-at ka pikungan te siyudad wey nekeg-iling ka kalayat din wey ka kaluag. Haspi ka an-anayan ne pabunsuran, sapiru ka igkarangeb, agata ka igkatelu, wey ismiralda ka igkeep-at. 20 Ne sardunika ka igkalimma, kurnalina ka igkeen-em, krisulitu ka igkapitu, birilu ka igkawalu, tupasyu ka igkasiyam, krisuprasu ka igkasapulu, hasintu ka igkasapulu wey sabeka, wey amatista ka igkasapulu wey daruwa. 21 Neelin ne pirlas ka sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne gumawan. 15 [xr]The angel that had_spoken to me, he carried a gold ruler in_order to measure the city and the doorways, and the fence. 16 The city has four corners and its length and width (are) the same. 22 Ne ware nakita ku ne timplu diye te siyudad su iyan e timplu ka Magbebaye ne Maresen ne Manama wey ka Nati ne Karniru. 23 [xr]Kenad e ne keilangan pad te layag te aldew wey bulan ka siyudad, tenged su iyan e eglayag dutu ka katelesan te Manama, wey te Nati ne Karniru. 24 [xr]Ne egkalayahan ka langun ne etew te kalibutan te layag din, wey egpanguyanen te me Hari te kalibutan ka langun ne karatuan dan diye. 25 [xr]Kenad eglekeban ka me gumawan su layun maaldew diye wey warad marusilem. 26 Ne egpanguyanen diye te siyudad ka langun ne karatuan wey ka imbantug te me nasud. 27 [xr]Piru ware egpakaseled dutu ne minsan nekey ne malindit wey ke minsan hentew ne malindit se himu wey ka me ubaten. Because only those can enter there whose name(s) (is/are) written in the book of the Lamb that is the Book of Life.

221 [xr]Nataman, impakita te panalihan keddi ka weyig ne egpakabehey te umul. Migpangilak-ilak seini iling te kristal, wey diye migpuun te trunu te Manama wey te Nati ne Karniru 2 [xr]wey migpahun-elat te dalan te siyudad. Ne ka tagse ilis te weyig due kayu ne egpakabehey te umul, ne egbebehas te nakalkalasi ne behas te tagse bulan, wey ka dewun kayi delemetan te langun ne etew te kalibutan. 3 [xr]Warad e minsan nekey ne indilus te Manama ne diye te siyudad.

221 [xr]Then, the angel showed me the river/water that gives life. It was sparkling like a crystal, and came from the throne of God and of the Lamb 2 [xr]and flow_in_the_middle of the street of the city. And every edge of the river has a tree that can_give life, and (it) bears different fruit(s) every month, and the leaves of (it) (are) herbal_medicine for all people of the world. 3 [xr]There was nothing there in the city which is_cursed by God.

Ne diye te siyudad ka trunu te Manama wey te Nati ne Karniru, ne egpamakayen sikandin te me suluhuanen din.4 Egkakita ran ka ulaula te Manama wey igsulat diye te me buked dan ka ngaran din. 5 [xra][xrb]Ne warad marusilem diye, wey kenad sikandan egkeilangan te layag te sulu wey te aldew tenged su iyan dan e kalayag ka Magbebaye ne Manama, wey eghari sikandan te ware egtamanan.

And the throne of God and of the lamb was in the city, and he was served by his servants.4 They will_see the face of God and his name will_be_written on their foreheads. 5 [xra][xrb]And there_is_no more night there, and they will_ no_longer _need the light of lamp(s) and of the sun because the Lord God will_be_their light, and they will_reign forever.

Ka peglibed ni Hisus

The returning of Jesus

6 Ne migkahiyan a te panalihan, “Egkasalihan wey malehet ka inlalag ku. Su ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne migbehey te Panisingan din te me prupita, migpeuyan degma te panalihan din eyew te pegpanugtul te me suluhuanen din ke nekey ka mahaan e egkeyitabu.”

6 And the angel said to me, “What I said is trustworthy and true. Because the Lord God that give his Spirit to the prophets, also sent his angel for storying to his servants what will_happen before long.”

7 Migkahi si Hisus, “Pammineg kew! Mahaan ad e egginguma! Keupianan te seeye se migtuman te langun ne intagne te seini ne baseen!”

7 Jesus said, “Listen! I am_coming soon! Well_being to those who obey all that was prophesied in this document!”

8 Sikeddiey si Huwan, ka nakarineg wey ka nakakita te langun ne nasulat te seini ne baseen. Te nakita kud wey te narineg kud seini, mig-usengul a diye te tangkaan te panalihan ne iyan migpapitew keddi te langun eyew te pegsimba kandin. 9 Piru migkahiyan a nikandin, “Kene nu himuwa sika! Iyan nu simbaa ka Manama, su suluhuanen e re degma te Manama iling keykew wey te me suled nu ne me prupita, wey seeye se egtuman te nasulat te seini ne baseen.” 10 Ne migkahiyan e pad man-e nikandin, “Kene nu iheles te me etew ka intagne te seini ne baseen su mahaan e seini egkatuman. 11 [xr]Seeye se mareet, egpepabulusen de due ne eggimu te mareet, wey seeye se mallindit, egpepabulusen de due ne eggimu te mallindit. Ne seeye se matareng, egpepabulusen de due ne eggimu te matareng, wey seeye se matulus, egpepabulusen de due ne eg-ugpe ne matulus.”

8 I (am) John, the (one who) heard and saw all that was_written in this document. When I saw and heard this, I bowed_my_face_to_the_ground in front of the angel who had shown me everything in_order_to worship him. 9 But he said to me, “Don't(sg) do that! Just worship(sg) God, because I (am) also just a servant of God like you(sg) and your(sg) siblings/friends the prophets, and those who obey what is written in this document.” 10 And he also said to me, “Don't(sg) hide from the people what is prophesied in this document because it will_ soon _be_fulfilled. 11 [xr]Those bad (people), (should) just continue doing wrong, and those dirty (people), (should) just continue doing dirty (things). And those righteous (people), (should) just continue doing righteous (things), and those holy, (should) just continue living holy.”

12 [xra][xrb]Migkahi si Hisus, “Pammineg kew! Mahaan ad e egginguma, wey eg-uyan a te unag eyew igbehey te tagse sabeka sumale te hinimuwan din. 13 [xra][xrb]Sikeddi ka Alpa wey ka Umiga,\f + \fr 22:13 \ft Ka Alpa iyan ka an-anayan ne litra te Grigu ne alpabitu, ka Umiga iyan degma ka katammanan ne litra.\f* ka an-anayan wey ka mewuri, ka bunsuranan wey ka katammanan.”

12 [xra][xrb]Jesus said, “Listen! I will_come soon, and I will_bring a reward to give to each one according to his acts. 13 [xra][xrb]I (am) the Alpa and the Umiga,\f + \fr 22:13 \ft The Alpa is the first letter of the Greek alphabet, the Umiga is the last letter.\f* the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”

14 [xr]Keupianan te seeye se migpami-pi te me kumbale dan su egbehayan sikandan te katenged te pegbaye te gumawan peendiye te siyudad wey te pegkeen te behas te kayu ne egpakabehey te umul. 15 Piru kene egpakaseled dutu ka me asu ne iyan ka mallindit ne me etew, ka egmamulingan, ka egmeyilabetey ne kene ne alunggun, ka me mangngimatey, ka migsimba te me diyus-diyus wey ka langun ne eggelebek eglilimbung.

14 [xr]Well_being to those who wash their upper_garments because they will_be_given authority for going through the doorway to the city and for eating the fruit of the tree that gives life. 15 But the dogs who (are) the dirty(pl) people, sorcerers, sexually_immoral (ones) (LIT meddlers without being_married), murderers, those (who) worship false_gods and all who always cheat/deceive won't be_able_to_enter there.

16 [xr]“Sikeddiey si Hisus ka migpeuyan te panalihan ku eyew te pegpataha kayi kaniyu langun ne due te me punduk te migmalintutuu. Sikeddiey ka kabuhalan ni Dabid wey ka malayag ne bituen ne Buntetale.”

16 [xr]“I (am) Jesus the (one who) sent my angel for making_ this _known to you(pl) all there in the groups of believers. I (am) the descendant of Dabid and the bright star which is the Morning_star star.”

17 [xr]Ka Panisingan te Manama wey ka eg-asaween egkahi, “Hendini ka!”

17 [xr]The Spirit of God and the bride say, “Come_here(sg)!”

Ne ka langun ne egdineg, egpakahiyen degma, “Hendini ka!”

And all who hear, must_ also _say, “Come_here(sg)!”

Ka langun ne nammaraan egparani, wey ka egkeupian ne eg-inum, egdawat te ware bayad ne weyig ne egpakabehey te umul.

All who are thirsty come_near, and those who want to drink, receive the water without charge that will_give life.

Ka pegpanaha-taha

The goodbye

18 [xr]Seini ka igpaney-paney ku kaniyu langun ne nakarineg te me tagne te seini ne baseen: ka minsan hentew ne egtimul te nasulat kayi, egtimulan degma te Manama ka legpad din ne iyan ka me salerep ne nasulat te seini ne baseen. 19 Ne ka minsan hentew ne eg-awe te minsan nekey ne intagne te seini ne baseen, eg-aween degma te Manama ka katenged din te pegkeen te behas te kayu ne egpakabehey te umul wey te peg-ugpe diye te Matulus ne Siyudad sumale te nasulat te seini ne baseen.

18 [xr]This is what_ I _warn (LIT say_in_advance) you(pl) all who heard the prophesies of this document: whoever adds to what_is_written here, his punishment will_ also _be_added to by God which is the disasters written in this document. 19 And whoever removes anything that was prophesied by this document, God will_remove his authority for eating the fruit of the tree that gives life and for living there in the Holy City according to what_is written in this document.

20 Ne migkahi ka migpamalehet te langun ne nakasulat te seini ne baseen, “Mahaan ad en iya egginguma!”

20 And the one_who_testified to all that is written in this document said, “I am_ really _coming soon!”

Malehet iya! Hendini kad e Hisus ne Magbebaye!

True indeed! Come(sg) Jesus the Lord!

21 Ka keupiya wey keyid-u ne egpuun te Magbebaye ne si Hisus, egkaangken niyu langun.

21 (May) the goodness and mercy from the Lord Hisus, be received by you(pl) all.
